This special project commemorating 80 years since the end of the war reexamines the history of postwar Okinawan culture and Japanese manga through the life and work of Shinzato, who could be said to be a missing piece in the history of manga.

In the Kingdom of Ha, a land bordered by monster-infested wilds, an ancient law dictates that any Bearer. a male capable of conceiving the White Tiger’s heir, must be crowned King to prevent a seven-year famine. After decades of silence, Il-Oh, a lowly slave, suddenly manifests as a Bearer. Following the omen, the former King abdicates, and the Crown Prince, Jang Woon, is demoted to a mere attendant tasked with serving the new, unwilling sovereign.

Within the palace, a grim secret lingers: once a Bearer bears an heir at age twenty, he is destined for death. Amidst this chilling tension, Il-Oh finds solace in Jang Woon, offering him his heart. However, as Il-oh turns twenty, the divine White Tiger, Geon-Yoo, descends to claim his prize. While Geon-Yoo seeks only to sire an heir and regain his freedom, Il-Oh faces a tragic fate. Because their performative "soft-launching" is on a whole other level, with their bold flirting often sending the entire office into a frenzy. Finally pushed to his limit, Murasaki snaps and threatens to break up. That's when Sugawa suddenly grabs him, kisses him hungrily, and growls something that turns Murasaki's world upside down. Leon, a former abandoned child taken in by a fallen noble family ruined by deceitful aristocrats, determined to repay the love and kindness shown to him by his new family, vows to restore their household.

Using his talent for magic, he enrolls in a magic academy with the goal of becoming a great mage.

While he is blessed with like-minded friends, worthy rivals, and dependable mentors, he also faces many formidable figures—such as arrogant nobles who abuse their status, and a suspicious second prince of the kingdom hiding something beneath the surface. Academy life turns out to be far more chaotic and eventful than he ever imagined!

For the woman he admired, that was supposed to be the case. Until they fall, it will not end. The curtain rises on the recurring “two days” that erode all reason.

Shuujun Kurata, a young man who possesses the power to "return by death," repeatedly relives the same two days with Yato Tsugahara—another girl aware of the loop—in a desperate attempt to save the woman he admires, Kotoka Sumi. However, no matter how many times he rewinds, Kotoka dies. As Shuujun sinks into despair over her unavoidable fate, Yato’s poison begins to seep in. "Let's enjoy each day together. Let your mind go blank and live each day to the fullest."

In a mysterious and unbalanced VRMMO, Kotatama, a humble blacksmith who is on the brink of disaster, tries to live a peaceful life, but...!

Ryu Su-Ho has trouble falling asleep every night. The only voice on Channel "J" that helps him sleep disappears one day. His insomnia returns, and he stops by a convenience store hoping to finally fall asleep tonight. He hears "J," the voice he thought he'd never hear again. He can't let go of the only person who can cure his terrible insomnia. In his haste, Su-Ho blurts out a few words to him...

A world devastated by dungeons and monster raids that suddenly appeared overnight. In this world, there lives a man who fights monsters with a single frying pan. His name is Woo Jung-Woo. He is a tool master, possessing a frying pan that grows stronger with effort.

206190.description:
Kang Su-Ji, the righteous crusader famed in high school for her intolerance of injustice. After marrying and returning to her hometown, she encounters Baek Hui-Do, her senior from her school days, as her neighbor. Yet for some reason, he displays blatant hostility toward her...

A precarious reunion romance between a woman who cannot tolerate injustice and a man who cannot tolerate her.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

206191.description:
What's so great about managing the Jianghu (river and lake) world? We, the pinnacle of gods and demons, secretly join hands, and when our heads grow uncomfortably, we help each other sort out our differences by lending a helping hand, and that's it. So-called peaceful Jiang-Hu, we leave a great mark on the history of Jiang-Hu, and each family and bloodline lays the foundation for a thousand years of glory and power. A liaison for each other? They're just expendable items. We make them dream for a while, and when their purpose is over, we discard them. A man and a woman cross the line on the verge of killing the rabbit and cooking the dog. The small ripples they create become a storm and sweep through the peaceful Jianghu.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206197.description:
The heart of the people is the heart of heaven, and what is for the people is the way of heaven. The greatest power to rule the world is not a blood-soaked sword, but the musical rhythm that comforts the hearts of the people! Here is a man who rises up to the world with a flute in his hand! Martial arts and sound! The path of the true absolute powerhouse, revered as a legendary warrior of the time, unfolds!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206198.description:
Who speaks of chivalry? Who rebukes the devil? The Heavenly Sword, a symbol of chivalry! The Magic Sword, a symbol of the devil! The door to legend and myth opens. Like a storm and a whirlwind, the fiery battle between two heroes sweeps across the fiery continent of Central Plains, engulfed in a raging tide of friendship!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206199.description:
Yongcheonsan, a child chosen by God, was born. From the moment he was born, he had to surrender himself to the fate God had ordained for him, and when he felt like crying, he had to laugh. He had to roll his body to prevent the passage of time from seeping into his living soul, and when faced with a cruel fate, he had to face it with dignity and not kneel. This epic tale of siblings fighting against the teeth of time that gnaw at their own lives to protect the destiny of their younger brother, chosen by God, unfolds.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206204.description: Countess Yuffie has a big problem: her so-called "older brother" Nate. He's brilliant, handsome, and talented in everything—but he's not human. With black wings and a mysterious aura, Nate is a supernatural being who once saved Yuffie as a child and then somehow claimed the role of her older brother. As she grows older and dreams of finding love, Yuffie’s every attempt at courtship is sabotaged by Nate's fierce protectiveness and suffocating affection. Despite her determination to break free from his grip, she finds herself blushing at his every over-the-top gesture. What exactly is Nate’s true intention? And is escaping his grasp really what her heart desires?

Angela is reincarnated into the world of an action-based otome game. However, of the two main characters, she is not the frontline female knight she was so fond of in her previous life, but instead the rearguard saint!? It would be boring if she was reincarnated but couldn't fight with weapons. So Angela, who is a muscle-brained girl, had an idea. Why not just cast a strengthening spell on herself? Angela immediately devotes herself to studying magic and doing muscle training, and stands up. Not to fall in love with the capture targets... but to wreak havoc on the battlefield! The long-awaited comic adaptation of this thrilling reincarnation fantasy with no rules!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

206221.description:
My father, who passed away leaving behind only a key, was a web novelist specializing in munchkin stories. Ten years later, the virtual reality game ‘The Another World,’ based on one of his works, became a platform of opportunity from basic livelihood to striking it rich and achieved unprecedented success.

Kim U-Ju, the author's child, lived a grueling life without any special advantages. He accidentally discovered that a key-shaped merchandise item from his father's estate was being traded at a high price. Immediately, he used the key to open a limited edition book in his father's study and received a special gift within the game. U-Ju accepted the gift, and afterward, the Great Demon King Lucia, a character from his father's web novel, appeared. The Demon King Lucia granted U-Ju powers, but the overwhelming strength left him in an awkward position, unable to even complete simple daily quests. After much deliberation, U-Ju brought in another work, Killer Zero, to eliminate the source of the power, the Demon King. However, Jason, a limited edition power user from ‘The Other World’ who sensed something amiss, burst in, leading to a confrontation.

Can U-Ju, armed with the strongest web novel characters, truly stand against the mightiest in the game?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The second princess is an apostle of the goddess. In order to hide this truth, Liewe was never allowed to appear in public, so he joined the Knights under a covert identity in order to fulfill his mission as an apostle. However, just before his 16th birthday, a strange ball is held in which anyone who can find the second princess will have the opportunity to propose to her! Liewe wants to remain a knight, so he decides to attend the ball dressed as a knight with Gideon, a fellow knight who is the only one who knows her true identity... But for some reason, the prince of a great nation approaches him! A love fantasy about a princess who hides her identity and joins the Knights.

206246.description:
Charlotte graduated from magic academy at the top of her class and was set to become an assistant to the highly paid royal magician. A rosy life was promised to her... But then, a letter suddenly arrived canceling her job offer, and it all crumbled away. She couldn't forgive such unreasonable treatment! To find out why, Charlotte headed to the sender, the royal magician, Clive, but... She found a man with cat ears and a tail! A love comedy about a magician who is currently reclusive due to a curse, and his cat-loving assistant, as they try to break the curse!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

A man with a keen sense of fear encounters a strange and distorted form of life. How will a single mutation change our lives, our lives, our future, and the world?! A horror series about ecological abnormalities!

206251.description:
Princess Hinaka, who has a faint crush on the military general Shikou, aspires to become a "Heavenly Empress" who can be granted special divine powers in order to help her childhood friend. However, one day, Shikou suddenly kills Hinaka's brother, the current emperor Kuroren, and usurps the throne. He then tells Hinaka, "From today, you are my wife," and holds her captive in the harem. In order to uncover the truth behind the sudden change in the person she loved, Hinaka struggles to "escape" from the harem, but...!?

Tomorrow you could become a target...!! A housewife who was reduced to a "lonely housewife" due to harassment from her mom friends tries to escape hell!!

Why don't you get drunk on me instead of alcohol? Miyuki, a serious office lady, is troubled by her bad drinking habits. She doesn't want her crush, Section Chief Shiraki, to know about it, so she tries not to drink at drinking parties...!?

Rikuto is a college student obsessed with self-improvement. One day, a fallen angel suddenly crashes into the home he worked so hard to build! A chaotic comedy about redemption starring 2 polar opposites!

From town to town, riding his beloved horse Storm, Hikari is a dashing hero who vanquishes evil with his twin pistols. Pen-kun, a street urchin, plots revenge against the man who imprisoned his father. But as he stalks him on his travels, the two eventually form a strong bond, becoming a legendary duo. A thrilling, timeless action adventure!

Suzuta Maya is a bright and cheery high school girl who also happens to be a streamer signed with a talent agency. But she's not the protagonist of this story. That honor belongs to her older brother, Jin—an unemployed loafer who may love his little sister a little too much, but whose heart is always in the right place. So when Maya goes to the dungeon to stream her battles, Jin happily serves as both cameraman and security guard. Everything changes when a trap sends Maya straight into an encounter with a deadly S-rank monster. Jin steps in without a second thought, unaware that his incredible feat has just been broadcast live to the world. Suddenly on the fast track to becoming a streaming sensation, Jin is about to discover what surprises await him in a modern world with a magical twist.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

206286.description:
After a night out with coworkers Soo-Hyeon meets his untimely death via car accident. Upset that he died a virgin, Soo-Hyeon curses his fate… only to be sent back to the land of the living as an incubus who must sleep with men. This complicates things when Soo-Hyeon’s awakening as an incubus leads to an intense encounter between him and Jin-Seong, his childhood friend and roommate. Amidst the confusion and physical intimacy, hidden feelings rise to the surface. What will the upcoming days hold for the both of them?

(Source: Tappytoon)

206288.description:
Seol, a former member of the violent gang Mimanpa, lives as ‘Snow’ in the so-called ‘Black Suit Gang’ led by Yong, after reuniting with him in prison following his sentence. Despite his delicate appearance, Seol has no interest whatsoever in the world around him. Handsome, who persistently fixates on him, was nothing but an annoying and irritating guy. For over a year, the Black Suit Gang evaded police pursuit with ease, enjoying unstoppable success. One day, acting on intelligence brought by Yong, they decide to rob a rural bank vault. It seemed like a foolproof job. But once inside the vault, their comrades go silent. Inside the vault, rumored to hold a chaebol family's hidden slush fund, Seol ends up seeing ‘Handsome's’ hidden face...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

206291.description:
Yeon-Mok is ordered by the Divine Emperor to find the first imugi born in 300 years and help him ascend to dragonhood, but Doya possesses none of the benevolent qualities expected of dragons. Despite Yeon-Mok's desperate attempts to guide him, Doya seems determined to walk a far darker path.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Rain That Devoured the Earth

206293.description:
Joo Yoon is tired of his classmate, Hyun Jaekyung, who often picks fights and bothers him for no apparent reason. Joo Yoon isn't the type who deliberately says mean things to others, a lot of resentment was built up in a short period of time. In a way, Hyun Jaekyung made him like this. But... was Joo Yoon being too harsh? When Joo Yoon visited to check up on him after the other had left in a hurry, he found Hyun Jaekyung with a puffy and flushed face as if he'd just been crying.

Hyun Jaekyung is an annoying brat who gets angry over every little thing, but strangely enough, it worries Joo Yoon when he's not around and it drives Joo Yoon crazy... Meanwhile, Jaekyung's looks alone are enough to drive him insane. It's clear that nobody except Joo Yoon would ever seriously consider being with him for life.

206295.description:
Shixue, princess of the country of Sei, where honesty is a virtue, was born without the royal ability to distinguish between lies. Despite being scorned by those around her, she has lived a strong life. One day, her greedy stepmother, Lu Furong, assassinates her father in an attempt to seize real power in the country, and installs her own son as the new puppet king! After being chased from the castle, Shixue is rescued by a mysterious, handsome young man named Jingsui, who dotes on her, and goes into hiding, but her heart aches at the sight of the people suffering under the new rule. Just as she is feeling powerless, she hears rumors of a recruitment drive for court ladies in the harem...

A princess despised for being without talent hides her true identity and uses lies and deceit as her weapons to take back her country...!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

206296.description:
When his father's company goes bankrupt, Ryuunosuke ends up working as a butler. He's tempted to woo his client, Yuki, who he's serving, because he's so cute, but he hears about the fate of each butler who made a move on him and decides to put his worldly desires to rest. However, Yuki, contrary to his appearance, boldly "provokes" Ryuunosuke, and ends up pushing him down...!?

A beautiful boy with pure eyes suddenly appears in front of Makoto, a female university student living alone in a rundown apartment that has been scheduled for demolition. Makoto ends up living with Tenran, a boy with a troubled past who has an otherworldly sense of money and a brain that rivals adults, for just one month during the summer vacation, on the condition that he helps with living expenses...!?

Erika and the delusional CEO Yaginuma are back!! But it seems that Yaginuma is no longer in his position as CEO. Now that he's no longer CEO, he's leaping into a new world based on his fantasies...!? And Yaginuma's handsome younger brother also appears!!

title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Shukuteki ni Deki Aisaresugite Komarimasu

206389.description:
Ko is a slightly unusual high school student whose hobbies include solo camping, and whose dream is to travel around the world someday. One day, he is suddenly caught up in his classmate's summoning to another world. Rather than being treated as an unfortunate afterthought, Ko leaves the royal palace behind and decides to pursue his dream using a mix of survival knowledge from Earth and magical power. A popular work originally published under MF Books, now adapted into manga form. Ko's first long dreamed journey begins in another world, as the laid back slow life of a high school survival expert unfolds.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ソロキャンパーのふらっと異世界気まま旅
title.romaji: Solo Camper no Furatto Isekai Kimama Tabi

206390.description:
Beta Ji-Han, who had a close relationship with his childhood neighbor and younger sibling, Yun-Seo, ended up in a relationship with her by accident. Afterwards, Ji-Han learned of the sudden pregnancy and that he had manifested as an Omega. The father of the child was undoubtedly Yun-Seo, an extreme alpha, but Ji-Han decided to terminate the pregnancy for the sake of Yun-Seo's future as a college student. However, Yun-Seo readily confessed that both Ji-Han's pregnancy and his trait change were part of his own scheme...

“You were always my omega, you've always been mine.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

206391.description:
Gil has lived his entire life as a gladiator. He knows nothing but the kill-or-be-killed environment of the colosseum. He’s never had a friend. He’s never felt pleasure or satisfaction. And he’s fine with that. Really, it’s fine. Then, one day, a fire breaks out, ripping across the colosseum and burning everything in its path. As Gil walks through the rubble of his former life towards freedom, he finds he… kind of likes it? Join a former gladiator as he discovers the joys and complications of a free life. Freed from his prison and let loose in a fantasy world of monsters and dragons, the former strongest gladiator is still ridiculously strong as a civilian!

(Source: Silent Manga Audition)

title.native: 「絶対王者」と呼ばれた最強奴隷の冒険譚 解き放たれた奴隷は、自由に世界を謳歌する
title.romaji: "Zettai Ouja" to Yobareta Saikyou Dorei no Boukentan Tokihanatareta Dorei wa, Jiyuu ni Sekai wo Oukasuru

206392.description:
Park Sang-Woo is a thoracic surgery chief who has lived without regard for means and methods for success. However, his life is turned upside down in an instant due to an unexpected accident. Unexpectedly, he returns to his rookie intern days and gains a special ability to see the remaining lifespan of patients. Using this ability, he tries to start the path of a true doctor that he had turned away from in his second life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

暴走パパ実娘強姦伝説 ~ウチの娘が…!?JK集団レイプ事件~

206402.description:
Lee Woon-Il, the founding chairman of Unjung Co., Ltd., which consolidated casino, liquor, construction, and lending businesses under one umbrella, and his successor, Chairman Lee Ju-Hwa. The sudden deaths of father and son, departing at the same hour on the same day, ignite a fierce power struggle within Unjung. Nam Dae-Gyun, the company's chief executive who confronts the power struggle head-on, and Kim Do-Jin, who finds himself unwittingly drawn into the conflict at a friend's request. This is their story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

206403.description:
The wizard girl Lily and her friend Ruri. What's their everyday life like!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.romaji: Ano Koro, Watashitachi wa Mahoutsukai deshita.

[Yongmang Danpyeonseon] Chingureul Sinyeoro Burimyeon Nampyeoneul Ppaeatginda
If You Hire a Friend as a Maid, You Will Lose Your Husband

206407.description:
“Shall we make a bet? If Ms. Mun Su-Ah disappears from my sight for more than 24 hours, she wins.”
“What if I lose? What happens then?”
“I do whatever I want.”

He ran his thick, long thumb sticky-smoothly beneath Su-Ah's lips. As her body stiffened from the strange sensation, he tilted his face closer. Su-Ah looked up at him, terrified yet trying desperately to act nonchalant. Seo Mun-Hyeon was smiling with the face of a victor. It was a proposal I had agreed to, but neither my heart nor my body was ready. Just as I was about to refuse him out of fear, our lips met.

(Source: Naver, translated)

This semi-autobiographical story is based on a dramatic episode from Yoshinaga Keisuke, the "King of Outsiders" who stars in "Breaking Down," during his time as the leader of a motorcycle gang, and is drawn by Abe Shuji, the fantasist in the delinquent manga world known for "Elite Yankee Saburo" and "Banchō Rengo"!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.romaji: Shiina Ringo: Kagami no Kuni no Ringo

206432.description:
Sa-Rang Yu, a second-year in high school, has never really fit in. She isn’t exactly bullied, but her classmates keep singling her out, even pushing the dares from their humiliation games onto her. No one says it out loud, but everyone senses something seriously off about her as the games take on a darker, more unsettling edge. Will these games help Sa-rang finally find acceptance among her peers, or will the escalating dares reveal the twisted side everyone suspects is already there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

206433.description:
After his mother remarries, Minseong ends up living with his stepsister, Sohyun. One day, by accident, he sees her naked. But something feels strangely familiar—the moles on her chest look exactly like those of a woman who appears on a secret, explicit account his friend once showed him. He tries to brush it off as a coincidence. Then a new post goes up on that account. [LewdRabbit – Today, my stepbrother came into my room without knocking… and I ended up showing him my body.]

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: My Story on My Stepsister’s Secret Account

206434.description:
King Zahir, ruler of the desert country of Maraban, is taken aback when he learns that his ex-wife, Sapphire, is visiting the country. Zahir divorced her five years ago, despite the fact they were still madly in love! Even after all this time, the moment the two meet again there's an undeniable attraction between them. But Sapphire hasn't returned alone-she's brought a secret back to Maraban with her!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: A Bride for a Billionaire II

206435.description:
Addison is a busy professional in New York who inherited a large ranch in Texas from Charlie, the older man who'd been her boss and mentor, when he passed away. She turns to the Wildes, a well-known family in the area, for help with the ranch, and they suggest that she wait to meet the family's youngest son, Jake. He's lauded as a hero after returning from active combat in the military, and when Addison sees him at his welcome party, she can't tear her eyes away. There's a despair hidden in his gaze... Addison is entranced by Jake, but he thinks she's just a tramp who cheated an old man out of his riches and treats her with contempt!

(Source: Renta!)

206436.description:
Jill, a divorced mother of two, is hard at work managing her bakery and raising her children. After receiving a lot of orders one day, Jill struggles to handle all of her responsibilities at once. In steps Connor, the best friend of her coldhearted ex-husband. Seeing the sheer amount of work that Jill has to do, Connor offers to help her out with the bakery and with her children. Though unsure of his intentions, Jill accepts his offer of assistance, but soon Connor expresses his true feelings and Jill is faced with a completely new problem.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シンデレラは涙を見せない

206437.description:
Maram finally has a chance to be with the prince of her dreams. Prince Amjad, the heir to the throne of Zohayd, had sent for Yusuf-but when he falls ill, Yusuf sends his daughter, Maram, in his place. Maram first met Amjad four years ago and she hasn't been able to get him out of her head since. Maram wants to mend Prince Amjad's wounded heart-after his wife betrayed him he became a cruel and brutal man-and now, in the dunes of Zohayd, she has her chance. Amjad's sublime beauty sets her heart aflame, but little does she know the prince has a wicked plan in store for her-one upon which rests the fate of all of the kingdom!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: To Touch a Sheikh Pride of Zohayd
title.native: 氷のシークと情熱の花嫁
title.romaji: Koori no Sheikh to Jounetsu no Hanayome

206438.description:
Ginny, who works at a hotel, and her boss, Rourke, have a cat-and-dog relationship. Ginny is repulsed, despite his attractiveness, by how Rourke constantly changes girlfriends. Rourke, on the other hand, thinks Ginny is pretty but cold and stubborn. Their quarrels are entertaining for the rest of the employees, yet when it comes to working on projects together, they make an undeniably excellent team. Then one day, Rourke asks for Ginny's assistance with a very personal matter...

(Source: Renta!)

206439.description:
Madalyn, an unemployed single mother, encounters Philip at a job interview-an interview, it turns out, with the CEO himself! She'd prepared herself for an inevitable rejection, but upon seeing her resume, he hires her as his secretary. Philip has the face of a prince, but he's a demon when it comes to work. Yet seeing Madalyn work so earnestly for the sake of her child makes Philip concerned about her somehow. Madalyn's heart is swayed not just by his gorgeous looks but by Philip's kindness, as well. So what will happen when she learns about the real reason Philip hired her...

(Source: Renta!)

206440.description:
Alexandra, the owner of a travel agency, agrees to look after the young child of her client, but when the woman doesn't return, Alexandra suddenly finds herself his unexpected guardian. With the help of some media coverage, Chase shows up, claiming that the boy is his nephew. He is a famous wealthy man whose amazingly handsome looks should be considered illegal. Despite his beauty, Alexandra disapproves of his arrogant attitude and the two end up quarreling. But, setting aside their heated arguments, Alexandra and Chase come to realize they must team up to find the poor child's mother.

(Source: Renta!)

206441.description:
To attend her sister's wedding, Claire returns home to Tahiti after six long years. What awaits her is her first love, Alain, who happens to be the very man who caused her to leave the island. Alain, a French businessman, thought Claire was a woman who enjoys seducing men, and his look of total contempt hasn't changed even after six years. He is the person Claire was hoping and dreading to see. Puzzled by her own feelings, Claire is utterly shocked by what Alain has to say to her after all this time...

(Source: Renta!)

206442.description:
Zacharo is a fashion house run by three sisters. Lily, who designs clothes for the line, is aghast when she discovers that her work has been stolen by another label. Who did it and how? She gets herself a job at the company in question as part of an undercover investigation and starts working as the CEO's secretary. Her boss, Nigel, must protect his family's long-established company and devotes himself to it. Lily wonders just how far he'd go to secure his company's future, and yet somehow she still finds herself inexorably attracted to her handsome competitor.

(Source: Renta!)

206443.description:
Lee despairs that she'll never meet the right man, since she seems to have a knack for dating all the wrong men. But maybe she doesn't need to meet Mr. Right-maybe she's already met him. Trevor has been her best friend since their college days, and Lee thinks he could be her perfect partner. But she'll need more than a best friend-she'll need sexual chemistry, too! To see if it could work, Lee proposes that she and Trevor become friends with benefits. He resists the idea at first, but eventually he caves and sleeps with her. Are these two friends the perfect match, or have they staked their friendship on a fleeting dream?

(Source: Renta!)

206444.description:
Jack's wife, Cassandra, is standing in front of him, but he just married another woman that very day! Cassandra was declared dead after she went missing while on a research expedition into the remote Amazon three years ago. Heartbroken, Jack quit his job as a professor and started a new job. Today he married his new boss's daughter. Faced with his first wife, Jack doesn't know what to expect, but he's completely blindsided when she introduces herself as his younger sister and ends up staying in the newlyweds' home. Now there are two wives in the house, and Jack must figure out how to be the right husband!

(Source: Renta!)

206445.description:
To claim his inheritance, Brett went to the funeral of a man he'd never met: his grandfather. When he arrives, he sees a young woman seated in the front row where immediate family members should be. Was this his grandfather's mistress? His grandfather had kicked out Brett's mother only to live in the family house with this woman? In the front row, Gayla is morning her loss of the man who'd been like a father to her. Tonight, Brett must stay in his grandfather's house with the woman he believes was his mistress. Little does he suspect that he'll end up comforting Gayla, let alone spending a hot night with her!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 嵐の夜すべてが始まる
title.romaji: Arashi no Yoru Subete ga Hajimaru

206446.description:
During her spring break, Isabella, a college student from the United States, visited Rome. There she met Antonio when she asked him for directions. Attracted to each other like magnets, they started dating after spending the night together. But the happiest moment of her life ends when Antonio dumps her without any explanation. That's when Giovanni, Antonio's older brother, volunteers his moral support to Isabella. While comforting her, he offers her a drink and suddenly Isabella finds herself caught between two brothers and accused of cheating! How is Isabella ever to win back Antonio's love?

(Source: Renta!)

206447.description:
Accused of being boring when she was dumped by her boyfriend, May decided to prove the world wrong by accepting a rich man's invitation to stay in a luxurious Manhattan hotel for five nights! But in the end, he never showed up. She came all the way to New York...only to be alone? The despairing May is encouraged by a friend to go on an adventure, so once May has bolstered her courage, she puts on high heels, goes into a fashionable bar and pretends to be a completely different person, cool and urbane. There she meets local author Beck Desmond. It's decided-this plain country flower is going to become a bright city light!

(Source: Renta!)

206448.description:
In an age of dragons and fairies,you could make a wish to the fire-breathers by sacrificing your most cherished possessions. In an age of digital assistants,you might just find J.J. as your own personal Secret Santa. J.J. is sent by her company's AI computer,Gem,to make River Sierra's wish come true before she realizes what it is-become River's fairy mother and marry her father,widower Raven Sierra. Will the pair have to crush River's dreams of a world with make-believe,or will the two discover that magic can still work its way through their lives?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: キャンドルを消す前に

206449.description:
While working part-time in a high-end department store in London during the Christmas season, Cassie recommends some candles to an especially gorgeous customer, who then buys half a dozen of them. When the man, Giancarlo, invites her to dinner, she turns him down. When he forgets to take his candles with him, she ends up delivering them herself. But when she arrives, a romantic dinner with a sexy man awaits her. Could there be any harm in sitting down at the table?

(Source: Renta!)

206450.description:
Bashful Violet is twenty-five and still a virgin. Afflicted by acne in her school days, she now stays far away from men, convinced that love is still impossible for her. But she's about to be surprised out of her rut when fortune comes calling at a New Year's Eve party!

(Source: Renta!)

206451.description:
Tallie is always trying to help others and getting into trouble for it. But those she saves are grateful to her and almost everyone in town likes her. Peyton is a competent lawyer who has known Tallie since she was little. He calls her a pest but has never stopped looking out for her. That must end. Peyton is from a distinguished family and he's planning to run for governor. Tallie can't cause him any more trouble. But can she give him up when she's been in love with him ever since she was sixteen?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: スキャンダルはおまかせ

206452.description:
One day, Rachel's friend tells her about her husband's affair. In that instant, Rachel's whole world crumbles around her. She married when she was seventeen years old and believed she had the perfect life with a handsome husband who loved her and their three beautiful kids. Her husband, Daniel, is a busy CEO, so Rachel never thought twice before about his staying out late for work, but was she just being naive? Thinking there's been some kind of mistake, she asks Daniel about it when he gets home, and he doesn't even try to deny her allegations!

(Source: Renta!)

206453.description:
While on vacation in Italy, Sonia decided to marry Francesco, a beautiful young man she'd only just met. They fell in love in Venice, the thrilling city of water, and it was as if they were under a magic spell. They should have lived happily-ever-after, but all too soon Sonia runs away, back to her hometown. She hadn't factored in the linguistic and cultural isolation of life in Venice, but what really drove her away was that she, with no family of her own, just couldn't get used to her husband's warm, loving clan. When her husband comes to find her, she rejects him again. Can there be any hope for a future between two so very different people?

(Source: Renta!)

206454.description:
The beautiful Princess Gabrielle is appalled to find out she's been married off without her consent. Her partner is the ruthless and rich businessman Luc Garnier, who stops at nothing to trap his quarry. But on the day of their marriage, upon seeing her husband, she feels an unknown sensation flow through her for the first time. She knows that the marriage has a large sum of money attached to it, and that love isn't part of the bargain, but she still suspects there might be something more! And despite viewing Gabrielle only as prey, unexpected feelings are budding within Luc, too.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 売り渡されたプリンセス

206455.description:
Life never goes the way Carrie expects, just like her stubborn curly hair. It was Friday the 13th and she was having a bad hair day. Unemployed and looking for a job, Carrie was on her way to an interview when she got into a collision with a luxury car. To make matters worse, the car's handsome driver was also arrogant! And her bad luck didn't stop with the damage to her car-when she arrived at the interview to meet the company president, Carrie is shocked to discover it's the same driver she just ran into!

(Source: Renta!)

206456.description:
After Paige graduates from college, she comes back home to California, where she is stunned by the desolate condition of her family's vineyard. Her father, who managed the vineyard, passed away two months ago. He was deep in debt and died of a heart attack as his accounts were coming due. Paige will have to sell everything, including the vineyard and the house, if she's to clear her father's debt. Then Brad, one of her father's creditors, shows up. This hateful man who ruined her father offers her an unusual proposal. If she marries him for only one year, he will pay off all her debts!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 謎だらけのプロポーズ

206457.description:
The story begins when middle schooler Ryuunosuke visits his grandmother's house on an island. As Ryuunosuke walks past the stairs leading to the second floor, a strange, plant-like thing extends down from above. Intrigued, Ryuunosuke tries to climb the stairs, but his uncle stops him with an uncharacteristically grim facial expression, saying, “What are you doing?” and “You'd better not go up there.” That night, however, Ryuunosuke's curiosity drives him to go upstairs after all...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

206458.description:
"The Unsmiling Phantom Thief," Smile, steals treasure yet again to stave off his crushing boredom. Quick on the getaway, Smile leaves the police struggling to catch him, but one day a rookie officer by the name of Gonza steps up to take him on...! Here's an action-packed escape-and-pursuit story by a new rising star!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

206459.description:
Mikuriya, a stressed-out salaryman who just got dumped by his girlfriend and is overwhelmed by work, encounters an ant colony struggling to survive in the corner of a park...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: おかえりミスターローリンストーン

206460.description:
In a world where humanity is all but wiped out in a war, two survivors, Yuno and Alice, live happily together. They may be the only two people left, but they are very, very happy…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

206461.description:
This anthology contains three bonus episodes for each of the comics featured in Yuujin no Shikijitsu: Ruu 1mm Sakuhinshuu, as well as an original manga that was drawn as a bookstore bonus when the comics were first released.

1. Nanashi no Koibito (ななしの恋人)
2. Frankenstein no Tomodachi (フランケンシュタインの友人)
3. Yuurei Yashiki Love Romance (幽霊屋敷ラブロマンス)

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Notes: Originally released at COMITIA 147, was then licensed by Futabasha for digital release with the addition of bonus manga.
synonyms: 友人と恋人 -『友人の式日』おまけ短編集
Yuujin to Koibito - “Yuujin no Shikijitsu” Omake Tanpenshuu

206462.description: That girl I'm curious about is the creator!? A world-famous comedy of youth!!

synonyms: 藍と金〜ダメな大人、ダメな子供
Ai to Kane: Dame na Otona, Dame na Kodomo

206465.description:
The man who captures many women but never gives them love... That man is Cesare Falconeri, king of the hotel industry. As his live-in housekeeper, Emma is provided with a comfortable lifestyle, but sometimes she is responsible for shooing out the women who stay in his master bedroom. Never did she think she'd be the one waking up in there! Three months later, Emma realizes that she's pregnant. But when Cesare finds out, his usual demeanor disappears-instead he fixes her with a cold gaze completely unlike that of the man she's known until now!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 愛なき富豪と孤独な家政婦
title.romaji: Ainaki Fugou to Kodoku na Kaseifu

206466.description:
Shelley is surprised to learn that her father died six months ago and left her an inheritance. After all, she grew up being told that her father was already dead! To find some answers, Shelley sets out to meet the family her father remarried into. There she finds waiting for her the Count of Hilvares, a man who looks like someone out of a movie. Can such a handsome man really be her stepbrother? He steals Shelley's heart at first sight, but when he lays eyes on her, he assumes she's only after the money she stands to inherit. What an arrogant jerk!

(Source: Renta!)

206467.description:
Aimee was about to be sold by her father. Fearing she will become a plaything for some repulsive nobleman, she runs away, escaping from London to Yorkshire. With a job as a governess, she has a fleeting dream of a steady life. But her new employer, Earl Bowdon, wants to make Aimee his mistress! Driven to despair, Aimee flees once again. What will become of her?

(Source: Renta!)

206468.description:
Deborah works small jobs on the side while traveling the world. One day on her travels, she loses her bag and in a panic runs in front of a car. Out of the car comes an Englishman named Gil Hamilton. A skilled businessman, he's shocked by Deborah's distressing and reckless story, but after hearing her name, he unexpectedly offers her a job. It turns out that she has the same name as his fiancee, and he wants her to pretend she is his wife! Will Deborah accept his strange proposition?

(Source: Renta!)

206469.description:
Irish is headed to Texas to find herself a rich, single man. She meets Kyle Rutledge at a lodge on the way. From the beginning, Irish is attracted to him, but even if he does have a perfect face and body, he is still a poor sculptor...or at least that's what she thinks. And she is determined to find herself a rich man. Kyle, on the other hand, is determined to win her heart despite her assumptions about him. Maybe later on he'll reveal that he is, in fact, a millionaire!

(Source: Renta!)

206470.description:
Jamie is a popular radio DJ whose PhD in human sexuality helps her solve all kinds of love problems. To increase her show's popularity, the radio station sets up a seduction game between her and Chase, a race car driver at his peak. Can Chase, a well-known playboy, win over Jamie in two weeks? Chase immediately begins to seduce Jamie, but she dodges his advances in order to hide her shocking secret-who knew that the renowned "sexpert" was still a virgin?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 秘密が明かされるとき

206471.description:
Whenever I get home, my wife pretends to be dead. What does that mean? Sometimes she's covered in blood or she has an arrow in her head, and other times she writes "katsuo" in a dying message... What is the wife true intention in pretending her death and welcoming her husband?

The questions posted on Yahoo! Chiebukuro caused a huge reaction and were shared with various online news outlets. On NicoNico Video, a song inspired by this question was posted by Hobonichi P, which has been viewed over 1.1 million times.

A husband who lovingly pokes at his wife, who makes a surreal but cute jokes, and sometimes slips it out. Ichida, who has a unique cynical style, comics such interactions between couples. New material not mentioned on the blog(?) also included!

It's a book that will make you smile and heal you.

(Source: PHP Kenkyuujo, translated)
synonyms: When I Get Home, My Wife Always Pretends To Be Dead.

206474.description:
On the day of his high school graduation, when white snow fell like his name, Baek Seol, who had secretly loved his junior Yu O-Geon, tried to confess his feelings one last time but met a tragic end. But years later, when they reunite by chance, O-Geon approaches him actively, unlike in the past. Baek Seol finds himself shaken once more by the feelings of his first love, which he had carefully tucked away...

Like that first cigarette, stale and musty from age, I should have discarded my first love before it went bad...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

206475.description:
After being imprisoned in a suspicious psychiatric facility and having her memories stripped away, Lexi finds herself rescued by a gorgeous man named Richard. For the first time in seven months, she steps foot in her home. Inside the magnificent mansion with its chilling atmosphere are Richard's mother, his half brother, Greg, and Greg's wife, Melissa. None of them seem to appreciate Lexi's return, though. Even Richard, the only one to show her any kindness, begins to reject Lexi. To make matters worse, he appears to have a particularly close relationship with Melissa. Richard was the only one Lexi wanted to put her faith in, but she now believes that he no longer loves her. So why did he bring her back to the mansion at all?

(Source: Renta!)

206476.description:
Tired of the boring company party, popular women's magazine columnist Lacey sneaks out to the pool, where she finds a stylish and sexy man. They both abandon themselves to passion on the spot…until Lacey finds out the man is actually Nate, a rival columnist for a men's magazine! How will she ever live down sleeping with this chauvinistic pig? She's supposed to be the champion of feminism! To make matters worse, Lacey's also forced to go head-to-head against Nate in her column! Who will win this battle of the sexes? What will triumph, sex or love? And what will become of the spark they started that night...?Tired of the boring company party, popular women's magazine columnist Lacey sneaks out to the pool, where she finds a stylish and sexy man. They both abandon themselves to passion on the spot…until Lacey finds out the man is actually Nate, a rival columnist for a men's magazine! How will she ever live down sleeping with this chauvinistic pig? She's supposed to be the champion of feminism! To make matters worse, Lacey's also forced to go head-to-head against Nate in her column! Who will win this battle of the sexes? What will triumph, sex or love? And what will become of the spark they started that night...?

(Source: Renta!)

206477.description:
It's been three months since Suzanna's sister and brother-in-law passed away in a tragic car accident. Since then Suzanna has been balancing her work with raising her nephew, Timmy. However, things soon take a turn for the worse as Timmy's uncle, Logan Bradford, attempts to gain custody of his nephew. Given the wealth and prestige of the Bradford family, the judge decides that Timmy would benefit from growing up on Logan's estate. Surprisingly, Logan invites Suzanna to stay at his home to help Timmy get used to his new surroundings. There, Suzanna sees a completely different side of a man she thought to be unpleasant, and now she finds herself unsure of her feelings toward him.

(Source: Renta!)

206478.description:
During a party for work, Francesca steps out onto the balcony for some air. There, a gorgeous, statuesque man stands alone in the moonlight. Extending his sturdy hand, he introduces himself as Severo, and her heart leaps as she goes to shake it. But as soon as they touch, a blazing shock courses through her body, forcing her to release his hand. What was that? Under Severo's unwavering gaze, her body is feverish. And then Severo suggests they spend the night extinguishing the desire burning between them!

(Source: Renta!)

206479.description:
Nadine didn't know what to do. She was asked to be a surrogate mother by her friend Lisa, and how could she refuse? But the agreement requires her to spend the night with Lisa's husband, Cameron, and Nadine is worried that the feelings she's long supressed might resurface. She has been secretly in love with Cameron for six years, and the morning after sleeping with Cameron, her heart is filled with regret. But then Nadine catches Lisa cheating on Cameron, and she must decide what that will mean for her and Cameron.

(Source: Renta!)

206480.description:
After her mother passed away, Elizabeth was going through her mother's things, when she discovered a letter that told her the true identity of her father. She decided to do whatever it takes to meet him, which means...becoming his caretaker? At least this way, Elizabeth decided, she can stay by his side. He takes a liking to her and she works hard as his devoted caretaker, but there's one man at the mansion who views her with suspicion. It's her father's adopted son, the coldhearted, hardworking Andreas. He's convinced she's out to steal the family's wealth. He orders her to spend nights working as his secretary so he can see what she's really like. Will he discover her true identity?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ベッドとオフィスで違う恋
title.romaji: Bed to Office de Chigau Koi

206481.description:
Eliza works as a seamstress at a bridal shop. One day, a million-dollar wedding dress enters the shop, which she is fascinated by and tries on, but for some reason is unable to take off. In a panic, Eliza flees the shop, and gets in a limo that had just arrived at that moment. Inside, she meets a handsome man in a tuxedo. Even though he is on his way to his own wedding, Eliza asks him for help. As he reaches out to assist her, little did they know, that they were headed towards unforeseen danger...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: ウエディングドレス 愛を運ぶドレス

206483.description:
Lim Su-Ho becomes entangled with Ju Chan-Mi due to the Korea University Student Council embezzlement scandal. Unlike Chan-Mi, who lives alone in a large apartment, Su-Ho faces eviction from his dormitory. Chan-mi offers him a place to stay in her apartment, and their cohabitation begins...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

synonyms: Only Two Years Left Until Humanity’s BAD END, and I’m the Only One Who Knows

title.native: 人類滅亡BADエンドまであと２年、僕だけがそれを知っている
title.romaji: Jinrui Metsubou BAD End made Ato 2-nen, Boku Dake ga Sore wo Shitteiru

206485.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

206486.description:
After saving another world and barely returning to my original body, I found myself transformed into a pervert who seduced the Empire's mad dog, Lexion, begging him to spank my butt. Trembling in fear from the man who looked ready to wring my neck at any moment, a system message I thought I'd never see again announced:

[System Message] The Destiny Quest begins. Getting Spanked by Destiny (0/100)?!

Before I could even question it, my soul-swapped body reacted sensitively to Lexion's touch. Nadia, who had never held a man's hand before, found herself unintentionally enduring days where her flesh and bones burned. A life that seems like M, yet isn't quite M, but still feels like M.

“Me, an M...?”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

206488.description: A new series depicting a lost story of the Earl of Poison, Cain Hargreaves. It starts with Cain saving a young girl named Rebecca from being killed by her father for a mysterious ritual.

206489.description:
"Looks delicious, Dan-ah."

The moment she heard Han-gyeol's words, her wetness poured out below. Dan nodded generously.

"You can eat it."

His lips carefully moved downward in a slightly hurried yet soft kiss. Han-gyeol never forgot what she taught him. Thinking he should touch her there with his tongue just because she told him to touch it—he really was smart.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.

title.native: ちょっとは我慢してくれ！

206491.description: After the death of her parents, Countess Clarisse lost everything to her uncle's family. To claim the only inheritance her parents left behind, she must recover the family heirloom, the magic stone, that was sold off. The one who now possesses that stone is none other than the ruthless Duke Albert, rumored to "use even children as tools of war"! But now, that very ruthless Duke is raising a baby with a rattle in his hand instead of a sword! Unaware of this, Clarisse visits the Duke's estate to strike a deal, only to encounter the dying infant, Theodore, and discover that she alone has the power to save him. Seeing her worth, the Duke offers her a deal: to become Theo's mother figure and in exchange, he will return the heirloom. But despite thinking she no longer needed a family, Clarisse slowly finds everyone around her starting to become obsessed with keeping her!

title.romaji: Yomei Wazuka na Kodomo no Mamahaha ni Narimashita

206492.description:
Tomakomai (43 years old) is an old office worker who has become a magical girl as a result of power harassment by the company president. She (he) settles in a magical girl village where the happy Nemuro (120 years old? I don't remember anymore) and Seikou (270 years old? I don't remember anymore) live, who can't live without alcohol. The magical girl life in this (illegally occupied) village filled with madness and despair begins!

(Source: Official Synopsis, Translated)

title.native: おいでよ 魔法少女村（不法占拠）

206493.description:
One day, Lucy visits Lorenzo, head of the Zanelli Merchant Bank, in order to save her late brother's company from collapse. However, due to a dreadful incident in the past that left Lorenzo with an undying resentment for Lucy's brother, he refuses to listen to her pleas. At her wit's end, Lucy says she'll do anything to save the company. Lorenzo isn't about to let that statement slide. After a forceful kiss, Lorenzo lures Lucy into a devious contract-now he'll have his revenge!

(Source: Renta!)

206494.description:
After her fiance abandons her, Vivienne spends her days in despair. That is, until Jack shows up. He has a mansion and a mission: to hire Vivienne as an interior designer. Vivienne has a professional history with Jack and knows his personality well: he doesn't take no for an answer. But when she sees a different side of him, she realizes how attractive he really is. He could be the sexy savior that heals her broken heart! He doesn't want marriage, but that suits Vivienne just fine. She asks him to make her his lover!

(Source: Renta!)

206495.description:
Matt is at his wit's end. As if he isn't busy enough with business transactions for the company he manages, he's left to take care of his ten-year-old daughter, Samantha, when his ex-wife passes away. Samantha rejects every nanny Matt hires. Just as the temp agency refuses to deal with him anymore, one of his employees introduces him to her younger sister, Tess. He learns that Tess is spending the summer at her sister's place, and he hires her as a nanny. She immediately befriends Samantha, but Matt doesn't expect to find himself falling for Tess's carefree charms...!

(Source: Renta!)

206496.description:
Princess Isabella was betrothed from a very young age to the king of Umarah, a desert country. Before getting married, she yearns for one last taste of freedom. She wants to go shopping, see the Eiffel Tower and do things that regular twenty-one-year-olds do... So she escapes... only to be promptly found in her beloved Paris. She has been trailed by Adham, a tall, dark-skinned man with scars and a dangerous aura. Isabella seizes a chance to evade her pursuer, and Adham relentlessly chases after her... but when he catches up to her, he steals a kiss!

(Source: Renta!)

206497.description:
"I found you, Cinderella! I won't let you get away this time." At work at the hospital, Brooke sees someone she never expected to meet again... Six years ago, she spent a single passionate night with him without even telling him her name. And now, talented doctor Jed Matthews is head of his department. Brooke pretends that she's never met him before, but he sees right through her, demanding answers about on what happened that night. She can't believe that he remembersed her-and the feelings she hasn't gotten over well up inside her. But Brooke has a secret...her five-year-old son.

(Source: Renta!)

206498.description:
Nora, a jewelry designer by trade, has agreed to accompany David to a social event-a direction she never thought her career would take! And yet here she is...posing as his girlfriend. He's so handsome it takes her breath away, but he's arrogant and it gets on her nerves. She endures it, thinking it's a onetime deal, but a few days later, he calls her again for another social engagement! And the feelings for him that she suppressed are threatening to resurface...

(Source: Renta!)

206501.description:
Kate awakens in a hotel suite and finds herself naked. Coming out of the shower is Michalis Theodakis, the heir to a global hotel chain. She remembers him saving her from men with ill intentions the evening before, but she never would have imagined that her savior would take advantage of her! When he becomes aware of what she's thinking, Michalis is thoroughly offended-if he had shared a bed with her, he assures her, she would certainly remember it. Kate apologizes when she realizes he didn't have any predatory intentions...but that doesn't mean he doesn't have any intentions at all...

(Source: Renta!)

206502.description:
For years, Andreas Xenakis had a single-minded determination to find Siena DePiero and exact his revenge on her for ruining his life. Siena, once a rich socialite, now works as a waitress to make ends meet after her father's company went into bankruptcy. The two meet once again and the attraction they felt all those years ago comes rushing back. Andreas is determined not to let his desire for Siena get in the way of his revenge, and Siena is overcome with the guilt of what she did to him. So when Andreas makes Siena an offer that is too tempting to turn down, what will they do? Will Andreas's anger overcome his desire for Siena? Will Siena summon the courage to tell him the truth?

(Source: Renta!)

206503.description:
Peachy had been saving herself for love, but after a near-death experience she decided not to hold back any longer. And if she was going to lose her virginity, Peachy felt that there was only one man she could give it to-Luc Devereaux, a devilishly handsome apartment building owner and her neighbor. Luc was hesitant to accept Peachy's proposal because he didn't want her to have any regrets. Luc tries to delay the event for as long as he can in order to give Peachy time to rethink her decision, but he is finding it more and more difficult not to follow through with her proposal...

(Source: Renta!)

206504.description:
Sarah, who works in the editorial department of a magazine, has been hiding her royal heritage-her family once ruled a kingdom that no longer exists. One day she's visited by Devon Hunter, the millionaire chosen as number three in the magazine's "Top Ten Sexiest Single Males" ranking. But he has something to tell her and it isn't about magazine business. He claims that her sister has stolen a priceless artifact from his home! But Sarah knows her sister wouldn't do anything to hurt their family name. In return for not taking this matter to the police, and with her grandmother the grand duchess's approval, Sarah must now go with him on a business trip to Paris as his fiancee!

(Source: Renta!)

206505.description:
Olivia, the eldest daughter of the prestigious Balfour family of Britain, is forced to work in Australia as punishment for disgracing the family name. Worse still, she has to work for billionaire, Clint McAlpine, who has a strong business connection to her father. "Why don't you come down from your ivory tower, Ice Princess," he sarcastically remarked before regarding her high status. But what does he think of who she is now? What's waiting for Olivia at the airport is hot, humid weather, and Clint. The stubble on his chin makes him look like a wild animal... At that same moment, she has a sudden rush of blood to the head, causing her to lose consciousness...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Olivia and the Billionaire Cattle King

206506.description:
A hot TV star has come to visit Clare's hometown! The entire place is excited to welcome Matt Sheffield, who plays the doctor and hero of a popular hospital drama series. Despite the festive mood everyone else is in, Clare is feeling blue. Matt is undoubtedly a very attractive man, and she can't take her eyes off him. But she mustn't get pulled in! He reminds her too much of an ex who hurt her badly... Yet she can't avoid him after she's assigned a seat right next to him at the ball and he asks her if they can spend some time together!

(Source: Renta!)

206507.description:
Simon is a wealthy womanizer who boasts that he will never marry. So why did he bid for bland and modest Emily at a charity auction? To fend off the crowd of women who want him, of course! Emily initially didn't mind that Simon, handsome though flirtatious, only saw her as his bodyguard. But once she got to know him, she was filled with a warm feeling of love like she'd never experienced before. He's out of her league if she stays the way she is, and so begins Emily's transformation out of baggy clothes!

(Source: Renta!)

206508.description:
One day a suspicious man shows up in Venus's bar with shocking news : she might be the long-lost granddaughter of a very rich man. Venus, however, has made it through life on her own so far and doesn't feel like she would fit into the stiff world of the upper class. When the man offers her money to accompany him to Atlanta, though, she decides to go along for the ride. There, she meets the perfect man, Troy, who also happens to be the vice president of the company her newly found grandfather owns. But even as the sparks of romance start to fly between them, Troy demands to know if she's only come for the money.

(Source: Renta!)

206509.description:
There is a reason why Jane wears a ring on the ring finger of her left hand. Because of her good looks, she has had male coworkers going after her and, in the end, she was forced to resign. So she came up with a strategy to pretend to be married. Her best friend tries to stop her by asking "What are you going to when you meet your Mr. Right?" But she didn't think true love would find her any time soon.... Jane joins a new company and lies about her marital status, and she falls in love with the CEO. She lies that she has a nice husband who looks like Tom Cruise, and now she cannot take her words back...!

(Source: Renta!)

206510.description:
Today is Dilly's wedding. The preparations were all steadily underway when she discovers a shocking truth from a conversation between the groom and her father. He proposed to her because he had his eye on some reward? It was all a plan devised by her father because he was worried about his thirty-year-old, single daughter. Thoroughly humiliated, Dilly runs up the aisle and out of the church still clad in her wedding dress. She jumps into the white limousine that was supposed to be used for her honeymoon and instructs the handsome chauffeur to drive away. Dilly just isn't meant to fall in love. She'll never be able to get married. While staring in astonishment at Dilly's angry antics, chauffeur Mick is roped into playing the part of her groom...?

(Source: Renta!)

206511.description:
Kayla can't believe she is sitting next to the gorgeous Matt on this airplane. In high school she was a geek, while Matt was very popular with girls. One fateful day long ago, he told her that she'd be very beautiful when she grew up and kissed her. But then Matt got married to another woman. Yet they are now heading to the Bahamas together to retrieve her grandmother and Matt's father, who have suddenly run off. Kayla's heart has been fluttering ever since she saw Matt, who has grown up and become even more attractive. What will become of them now that they are on a trip to an island known for romance?

(Source: Renta!)

206512.description:
After losing both her parents, Briony Winters was adopted by a distinguished family in Britain. Since then, she has led a wonderful life...until she found out that the lady of the house, her godmother, Lady Ashworth, left a will with a shocking clause when she died. The will stipulates that to inherit the estate, Briony must marry Lady Ashworth's nephew and only blood heir, Luke Kingsley, who is also a famous hedonist. If she refuses, her friend Mary could lose her shop and Briony's servants will be out of jobs. To protect her friend and her staff, she has no choice but to marry this playboy Luke, yet she is hesitant to enter a loveless marriage. However, after one passionate kiss at their wedding, she feels something stirring in her body...

(Source: Renta!)

206513.description:
Three years ago, Natalie was treated like a child and dumped by Christo, a handsome lawyer, when she was working as a clerk at his law firm. She's grown up since first becoming infatuated with his kisses, and she thought she'd gotten over him-but now they're working together, and the two of them find themselves sharing a bed again. Just when Natalie is balking at the fact that the only requirement of their temporary relationship is that they won't ever get married, Christo makes a cruel request... He wants her to pretend to be his fiancee to please his dying grandmother.

(Source: Renta!)

206514.description:
Tess Monahan grew up surrounded and protected by her five brothers, and her current life has nothing to do with romance. Still, when she almost collapses on stage while being awarded the "Teacher of the Year" award at the school where she teaches, a coworker speculates that she must be pregnant. The rumor about her pregnancy spreads through town like wildfire even though she's still a virgin! Her first love, Will, believes the rumor and offers a gentle, helping hand. But the way he looks at her has changed, and he's stopped treating her like a child.

(Source: Renta!)

206515.description:
Victoria isn't good with men. She doesn't want a boyfriend or a husband-she just wants a baby... She's decided that Caleb, the owner of a newspaper company, is the best candidate for the job. Now she just has to seduce him and get him in the mood. Rumor has it that Caleb is a resolute bachelor and a playboy, making him the perfect choice. There's no way he'll be interested in marriage. So Victoria dares to slip into a sexy dress and attempts to seduce Caleb. He's shocked by demure Victoria's sexy transformation, but he firmly refuses her offer. He's in for a surprise when he discovers her newspaper advertisement the following day-"Wanted: A Man to Father a Child."

(Source: Renta!)

206526.description:
It's the last training camp before graduation. I return home with Ura, a guy I've long adored... Wearing his clothes, sleeping in the same bed... and yet, he doesn't make a move on me?

"Why won't you look my way?"

The moment I tug on his shoulder, I notice Ura's blushed expression and nervously stiff body... He may seem calm and composed, but it turns out that was anything but the case. After seeing that... There's no way I can stop now!

(Source: DLsite)

title.english: Because Ura Wants To Be More Than "Just An Acquaintance"

title.romaji: Ura-san no "Tada no Kouhai" kara Nukedashitai kara,

206527.description:
Sex at night. Sex at 5 in the morning. Then face to face at 8 for the morning assembly.

My "relationship" with Mr. Munakata began in Spring... when I was appointed at a new teacher to the same campus.

...and no-one suspects a thing...

(Source: DLsite)

title.english: Mr. Munakata Is LUSTING AFTER A New Teacher Like Me
title.native: あの宗像先生が、新人教師の私なんかに欲情してる
title.romaji: Ano Munekata-sensei ga, Shinjin Kyoushi no Watashi nanka ni Yokujou Shiteru

206529.description:
After being orphaned as a child, Yuito was taken in by his distant relatives, the Sakaki family. His new parents raised him as lovingly as if he'd been their biological son. He got on just as well with his new big brother, Keita. Their brotherly bond stood the test of time, lasting all the way into their high school years. But, at some point along the way, Yuito fell in love. Ever since, he's kept his forbidden feelings for his brother to himself.

One day, Yuito happens upon a shady-looking café that serves strange, exotic tea blends. The owner offers him a drink that will make the person he loves do anything he asks. Skeptical but willing to give it a try, Yuito downs the drink... That night, he musters up the courage to ask Keita to kiss him. How will Keita respond...?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The World's Coolest Big Brother Is In Love With Me!
title.native: 世界一かっこいい兄さんが僕に惚れちゃいました！？
title.romaji: Sekaiichi Kakkoii Nii-san ga Boku ni Hore Chaimashita!?

synonyms: The Villain that Reincarnated into the World of a BL Game goes Astray

title.native: BLゲームの世界に転生した悪役令息は、グレてしまいました
title.romaji: BL Game no Sekai ni Tensei Shita Akuyaku Reisoku wa, Gurete Shimaimashita

206531.description:
A car collision marked the end of Chen Chao’s five-year relationship with Sheng Ruzuo. Just as Chen Chao anticipated starting anew, Sheng Ruzuo resorted to multiple pretexts to hold onto him. Simultaneously, a savior named Jiang Youlin emerged, triggering lost memories from five years ago, along with the revelation of a supposed younger brother who didn’t exist. As a cascade of truths unraveled, Chen Chao came to understand that the past events were not as he had perceived them. Now faced with their outdated bond, the question lingers: can it still be salvaged?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

206535.description:
Fleur, working as a nurse, lives with her seven-year-old son, Alex, after the death of her husband, and goes back to work for the first time in two years, encouraged by her friend at the hospital. On her very first day, she performs botched work. She relives her traumatic experience she went through with her late husband when her patient is brought into the resuscitation room. She fails to do her part and runs out of the room. Newly hired Italian doctor, Mario, gets angry with her. That night, Mario suddenly pays a visit to her when she is feeling down...?!

(Source: Renta!)

206536.description:
Claire was in the world-class resort destination of Monaco to find her father, a renowned thief. Rumor had it that he was after the grand duke's crown. She is rushing to stop him when she suddenly meets Luke, who is as handsome as a dreamy British aristocrat. And somehow Luke keeps showing up everywhere she goes-is he after the same crown as her father? And in the end, will he choose to steal the jeweled crown or something far more precious?

(Source: Renta!)

206537.description:
Strong-willed Samantha has led a life without love. Even when she follows her friend's advice to make herself more feminine, she still has no idea how to get a man. When she meets her boss, a playboy sheikh named Bandar, he finds her conceited, yet he is completely taken in by her beauty at first sight... Perhaps he could be the one to teach her how to love...

(Source: Renta!)

206538.description:
Melissa Swift, an ER doctor, went on a holiday to Italy for some much-needed relaxation. While she's unwinding on the beach, a boy is severely injured in an accident, but thanks to her skilled care, she's able to save the boy's life. Later at the hospital, she meets the emergency room doctor, Mateo, who also happens to be the boy's father! He is strikingly handsome, and his deep brown eyes begin to make Melissa's heart beat faster. Mateo is overwhelmed by gratitude for Melissa's kindness...but there's something more there, too. His words are as sweet as chocolate and Lissa is melting in the face of his passion. But Lissa has made up her mind never to fall in love with anyone again. Will this rare encounter spark the true love she never hoped to gain?

(Source: Renta!)

206539.description:
Zach Masterson can't believe his ears. Not only does Sarah not know what a credit card is, she has never even gone shopping before! Sarah Solomon was found camping alone on Zach's ranch. She is a beautiful yet peculiar woman who was born and raised in a community with century-old religious views and lifestyles. After losing her mother, she fled from her abusive stepfather and discovered the outside world for the first time. Despite her worries, Sarah remains hopeful in her search for a place where she truly belongs. Zach, on the other hand, is ashamed of his roots and on the verge of abandoning the place he once called home.

(Source: Renta!)

206540.description:
One Friday evening, a large bouquet of beautiful white roses is delivered to Sarah just before the end of the workday. The card says they're from her secret admirer. Rumors spread rapidly through the company about who the sender could be. But Sarah is at a loss. She has absolutely no idea. But suddenly, raising her eyes, she notices her boss, Matt, staring at her. Could they be from him? Because he's the kind of secret admirer she could really get on board with!

(Source: Renta!)

206541.description:
Country girl Henrietta has been abandoned quite suddenly by the man she thought of as her sweetheart. While grieving in the shadows during a London ball, she meets a man who is bewilderingly handsome. That man is Count Deben, and he has a reputation as a playboy. Perhaps he's grown bored of the girls who swarm to him like bees to nectar, but why would he be interested in her? Henrietta is surveying him cautiously when Count Deben directs a challenging gaze her way and declares that he will make her the brightest flower of high society.

(Source: Renta!)

206542.description:
Alex is a single mother who teaches at a local high school. Competent lawyer Nolan lives right next door. He lost his wife and is raising his son on his own. Alex and Nolan are best friends and their children get along really well. It's a platonic, peaceful way of life. But when Nolan confesses his attraction to Alex, their carefully cultivated friendship suddenly hangs in the balance. Will Nolan's confession undermine their friendship or will it transform it into something even better?

(Source: Renta!)

206543.description:
Rafael, an arrogant and ruthless businessman, stole a kiss from Isobel at her eighteenth birthday. And he's the fiance Isobel's family has forced on her! All he wants is her status as an aristocrat. In return for the marriage, her family will be saved from bankruptcy. But rather than suffer a loveless marriage, Isobel leaves her home and high society to moves to Paris, where she makes a modest living by teaching tango. But before her twenty-first birthday, Rafael unexpectedly shows up in her class, takes her hands and starts dancing with her!

(Source: Renta!)

206544.description:
Annabelle's life has become a dream. She was a nurse at a small hospital in America until the CEO of Amalfi, a famous Italian car brand, became mesmerized by her beauty and asked her to become Amalfi's campaign girl. Annabelle was staying at a villa in Italy during the span of the photo shoot when Lucca, the CEO's son, suddenly appeared out of nowhere. Lucca's gray-green eyes and overwhelming aura stun Annabelle. Until, glaring down at her, Lucca accuses her of being his father's mistress!

(Source: Renta!)

206546.description:
Kaye was asked out on a date by Formula One world champion Jared. Completely smitten with the famous playboy, she gave him her virginity. But after they consummated the act and Jared realized she had been a virgin, he turned away from her. Kaye's first love was cruelly trampled on. But her pain wasn't over yet. She had gotten pregnant from her one-night stand, and she was unable to get in touch with Jared. So Kaye raised her child alone for six years. Until one day when Jared showed up again...

(Source: Renta!)

206547.description:
The wedding reception of her ex-boyfriend is not where Callie wants to be. When she escapes to the balcony, she meets the mysterious Nick. Mesmerized by his inviting green eyes, she decides to forget reason for the first time in her life and they spend a passionate night together. But the next morning she is stunned to learn who Nick is-a famous billionaire and the brother of the bride! Callie leaves while he's sleeping, not knowing that fate will reunite them again...

(Source: Renta!)

206548.description:
CEO Jesse is rumored to be an unfeeling "machine." But deep in her heart, she's burning to get revenge on her father. Her hateful father laid his hands on his housekeeper, her mother, and eventually drove her to her death. Jesse's determined to expose his illegal actions and have him sent to jail. A crucial part of her plan involves the buyout of his company, but suddenly a man appears who's about to spoil her plans. His name is Luc Sanchis, a billionaire whose many affairs with glamorous women are known all over the world. Reluctantly, Jesse kidnaps Luc and takes him to a deserted island. But Luc remains perfectly calm, and in fact, he ends up seducing her!

(Source: Renta!)

206549.description:
Trish's first love was Adam, a man sixteen years her senior. Figuring there was no way he could love her back, she pulled away from him, but now it's four years later, and she has met him again at his engagement party. Adam is more attractive than ever, and his lovely bride-to-be seems like a good match. Trish wonders what might have happened if she hadn't run away all those years ago... She returns to her hometown on a remote island, hoping to soften the sting of her regret. Her relief doesn't last long, though, as Adam has followed her there! What could he possibly be thinking?

(Source: Renta!)

206550.description:
Lily's house has been sold by her stepmother and she has to move out right away. The buyer is a gorgeous man named Ciro. But she's certain his charming mask is hiding a coldhearted businessman. Unexpectedly, he visits her right before she must move out and invites her to dinner. Then he offers to pay her brother's college tuition and asks her to marry him! She's been shying away from men ever since she made love to and was promptly dumped by her ex-fiance, yet she begins to think that Ciro is a man she can trust...Until she learns after the wedding that what Ciro was dreaming about was a "pure" bride.

(Source: Renta!)

206551.description:
Catherine has been living half a globe away from her husband, Vito, for three years now. For as long as he can remember, their son, Santos, has never seen his mother and father together. Vito was looking forward to the next of Santos's periodic visits, but his new lover, Marietta, isn't happy about having Santos in the picture. To protect Santos from Marietta's cruelty, Vito hatches a plan to live together with his wife and son as a family once more. Though her old wounds haven't healed and the fire of their love has long since gone cold, Catherine finds her heart racing at Vito's touch. Are they living together for Santos's sake alone?

(Source: Renta!)

206552.description:
That summer when everything was glimmering, disaster struck. If it weren't for the death of her older brother, Charlotte would have gotten married to Rohan, her first and only love. However, after Rohan was blamed for the death and left town, Charlotte could no longer wait for his return and married her childhood friend, Martyn. But even then, the chains of sorrow would not release her. After her husband dies in a car accident and her family goes bankrupt, their family mansion is sold off to a complete stranger. Shattering the last of her pride, the mansion's new owner turns out to be Rohan...back with a vengeance!

(Source: Renta!)
