206553.description:
Julia is always at the beck and call of her selfish and criminally handsome boss, Sebastian. However, she explodes with anger when he asks her to break up with his girlfriend for him. This time he's gone too far and Julia has had enough. She announces that she's quitting, but she never could have anticipated his reaction. He tells her that, though he would never pursue his secretary, he has no problem setting his sights on an ex-employee. Julia's resignation has unexpectedly lifted Sebastian's self-induced ban on her seduction! (The story His Accidental Fiancee is also included in this volume.)

(Source: Renta!)

Kotani Kohei works as a weekly magazine editor at Dankosha, a major publishing company. Having graduated from an unknown university, Kohei joined Dankosha as a part-timer and performed odd jobs for many years before becoming an editor as a contract employee, which made him feel uncomfortable around the more highly educated employees around him. Kohei is assigned to write an article about elementary school entrance exams, also known as "ojuken." Kohei has a young son and has negative feelings about "ojuken," but then an incident occurs that shakes his values...

Since she was just a child, Lydia was determined as the daughter of a Marquis to do everything in her power to support the royal family. However, everything seems to be changing before her very eyes as her fiance Rogerio begins showing romantic interest in a lowly noble aide to the princess. While ignoring their duties, the two seem to be getting awfully familiar... and yet Lydia seems to only be treated as an antagonist when confronting the situation. Feeling betrayed, her manners and patience have reached their limit...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

A saint of calligraphy and painting who has reached divine heights! From the prestigious Yemunsegae family of Hoseo, Sogaju Lee Gun-Ak has been called a prodigy since childhood. Born into a family, Gun-Ak is caught up in the conflict between the seven great clans of the Central Plains and, as a descendant of Hwaseong, demonstrates mystical calligraphy. Mysterious pursuers of unknown origins gradually approach, and he experiences the tragic murder of his father...

The life of Shin Pil-Hwa, a divine calligrapher who captures the world in his paintings!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206587.description:
Even though he has acquired the world's greatest martial arts skills, he does not seek fame and thus does not enter the martial arts world. He is called a true great man. Admiration and respect are met with jealousy. Even the royal family... and the greatest martial arts masters try to undermine the great man's status. Finally, a great man who has accepted an unwanted call and entered the martial arts world. His sword is hotter than the fire and brimstone of hell. The world will burn...!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206588.description:

For the glory of martial arts… To receive the blood debt of the past… Sometimes, for a love deeper than death… Blood will splatter across the martial arts world.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206589.description:
Akimitsu Tsukasa was summoned to another world with his classmates, but due to the betrayal of the friend he thought was his best friend, he ended up wandering alone in an unknown world. Tsukasa drifts to Aiguille, where a horned race of demons live, living every day on the edge of death as a "freelance mercenary," relying solely on the out-of-date magic "In-Jutsu" (Seal Technique) he received as a gift at the time of the summoning. One day, Tsukasa's childhood friend, Matsuzaka Mihono, suddenly visited him, asking him to "save my sister, Shihono." What is the condition that he makes with Mihono?

Lady Mertia Waykins is forced to marry Lord Arthur, a terrifying chieftain of the north, to broker peace for her kingdom after a long period of war. After being attacked in her own home during the war, Mertia has been unable to open her eyes around men. Though initially terrified of how Arthur will react, she's stunned by how patient and gentle he is with her. As he shows her how beautiful her new home is and how kind its people are, Mertia finds herself wanting to learn more about the north and her warrior husband.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: La Mariée Bien-Aimée du Guerrier du Nord
เจ้าสาวสุดที่รักของนักรบแดนเหนือ

title.native: 北部戦士の愛しい花嫁

206623.description:
Keita runs away from his strict home and arrives in Seoul, South Korea. Determined to become the K-pop idol he has always dreamed of, Keita auditions alongside his rival, Sujin...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: スーパースパークルスターズ

206624.description:
A simple story about a young piano player and his secret dragon admirer.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 45.

206625.description:
I love it when people call me carefree—that's because my Normal Person camouflage is working☆ Running on fumes every day! But I'm still alive! Your girl Happy proudly presents the ultimate happy survival show!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: にこにこ元気☆ハッピーちゃん

206626.description:
When his wife and child are attacked by a ghost, he desperately calls an exorcist for help... A new era of horror story!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

206628.description: Note: Published in Jump GIGA 2018 SUMMER vol.2.

206629.description:
A new chapter begins in the long-awaited gourmet comic series "Osen"!!!

Handa Sen, also known as "Osen," is the proprietress of Isshoan, a traditional Japanese restaurant hailed as the flower of Kasagi. She serves exquisite dishes made with the finest seasonal ingredients to thrill your heart. A stylish and spirited woman, Osen has created a new gourmet space for the Reiwa era. Whether you're young or old, male or female, please stop by!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

206630.description:
Shiina, an artist who hates magic, meets Natsume Nana, a girl hospitalized in a hospital where magic is banned... The two become friends through drawing pictures, but...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

206631.description:
Contains:
- Sepia de Nagareteku
- Itsuka Kimi wo Miteta
- Ano Koro no Sora - Kono Koro no Aki

synonyms: My Rival is a Cute Boy

206633.description: Note: this manga never received a tankoubon release.

title.native: めんたんぴんリーチうるトラ！！
カーリー・ポメラニアン

206636.description:
I need you. An unexpected confession from the boss she has unrequited feelings for. But soon after, Alli's hopes are shattered completely. Mark is only looking for a capable nanny to care for the niece he recently took in, and the one he's chosen for the job is his assistant: Alli. But when they suddenly start living together, Alli's heart can't stop from going crazy. One night, Mark kisses her passionately, and Alli is entranced. But a moment later, he rejects her, and she feels like she's just been doused in ice water. Alli tries to control herself and stay calm-could it be that he's doing the same...?

(Source: Renta!)

206637.description:
Iris, a geologist, visits Kadar in the Middle East for her job. Waiting for her is a reunion with her ex-lover, Asad, the sheikh of this country. Six years ago, they were university students and fell in love, but one day Iris was suddenly dumped. After he left, she learned that Asad was the sheikh of a desert nation and had gotten married to a princess from a neighboring country. Although she was determined never to be at his mercy again, her heart is stirred by the passionate gaze of Asad-and finds the king of the desert has already divorced his wife.

(Source: Renta!)

206638.description:
While working her job as a waitress, Gypsy runs into a man she never thought she'd see again. The man who's haunted her dreams for the last two years...Rico Christofides! Two years ago, they fell for each other and shared a night of deep passion, but once daybreak came, he was gone. Gypsy had no idea why...until she turned on the TV news that morning. Rico is a world-famous business magnate and a sworn enemy of her late father! Now fate conspires to reunite them. She has to escape, no matter what...and keep the secret she's carried ever since that night they spent together!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 独裁者に誘惑された夜

206639.description:
Juliette, a destitute seamstress living in nineteenth-century London, comes upon a man being attacked by ruffians in the dead of night. Instinct takes over, and she pelts them with potatoes to save the man. He is Sir Douglas Drury, a courtroom lawyer and a baronet. His mind in a haze, he calls out to her and plants a sweet, passionate kiss on her cheek. When he wakes up, though, he's forgotten all about the kiss and treats Juliette as his servant, but when Sir Douglas's mysterious assailant targets Juliette's life, she pretends to be Sir Douglas's lover and makes her debut in high society in search of the culprit!

(Source: Renta!)

206640.description:
Holly is managing her sister's restaurant while she's in the hospital, and in order to prepare for a banquet, she's visiting the home of the most prominent family in town, the Madigans. In addition to preparing the food, Holly also finds herself wide-eyed with surprise when she sees a refined Simon entertaining his guests. Can he really be the same arrogant man who was scowling and shouting at her just a few hours earlier? In his black dinner suit, he's extremely distinguished and incredibly gorgeous. Despite his earlier behavior, Holly suddenly feels her heart begin to beat wildly!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 愛の言葉を花束にして
title.romaji: Ai no Kotoba wo Hanataba ni Shite

206641.description:
"You've won a trip to visit the old castles of Europe as well as a luxurious spa," reads a letter that arrives at the bookstore where Sara works. The only problem is, she doesn't remember entering any contest! Her heart still stung by old wounds, Sara isn't particularly interested in claiming her prize, but her friend badgers her into leaving for the Kingdom of Carvania anyway. But when she arrives, he's waiting for her?Aleks, her old lover who vanished without so much as a word five years ago. He's the owner of the castle where she's staying...and the prince of Carvania! With cold eyes, he leads her to a young boy's sickbed and tells her he's brought her there so she can be an organ donor for the boy...the son she abandoned years ago!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 時の魔法にかけられて

206642.description:
After both her parents died, Aggie lived her life earnestly and in poverty. Then one day she meets Luiz, a wealthy multimillionaire, who claims that Aggie's brother has eloped with his niece just to get his hands on her money! Luiz then takes Aggie on his journey to bring back the two, by force if necessary. While they are in pursuit, a giant snowstorm blows in, slowing their progress and forcing them to bunk together. In spite of Luiz's arrogance, she can't take her eyes off him, and even though she can't stand being around him, the tension between them slowly thickens...until he finally suggests that they release their fiery passions!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 愛が見えない億万長者

206643.description:
Claire takes off to Italy after her best friend, Grace, asks her to stay by her side during her pregnancy. Claire thought a new life in Italy would be the perfect opportunity to forget her unhappy past. However, her heart is stirred by the beautiful yet unapproachable man who welcomes her at the airport, Romano. He speaks to Claire rudely and treats her like a child, and Claire is sure that they will never get along. And that is just as well, since she's also sure he would never choose her if he knew her true self. But when the scars of her abominable past are revealed to Romano, she is shocked by his response!

(Source: Renta!)

206644.description:
After her mother chose to remarry Wade, the owner of a ranch in Canada, Brenna and Nathan became stepsiblings. Despite her suspicions that he is a devil in disguise, Brenna is captivated by his charm and ends up spending the night with him. Once she finds out the truth about the Wade family, though, she packs her things and runs away to England. However, after one year, he suddenly reappears in her life. Although she is taken aback by their sudden reunion, she can't help but fall victim to his charm, just like last time...

(Source: Renta!)

206645.description:
When Zach and Tess got married, everyone was overjoyed and thought they were the perfect couple. Quiet, strong and reliable Zach was looking for a wife, while hardworking single mother Tess needed a new husband to support her family. But Tess secretly pines for another man. Too bad Zach has caught on.

(Source: Renta!)

206654.description: Note: this work never received a tankoubon release.

206660.description:
Beom Tae-Gyu's violence began in the summer. A good son, good grades, a good university. Seon-Woo Jung, who spent his days suppressing his emotions under his parents' pressure for good grades, felt an intense jolt when he was unexpectedly assaulted by his classmate Beom Tae-Gyu. Just as he was secretly enjoying violence as his sole solace and escape...

“Fuck. Did you... get a boner...?”

He was caught. By none other than Beom Tae-Gyu.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206661.description:
“I'll Take Care of This Marriage.”

Just before the wedding uniting two chaebol families, the bride vanishes. Her younger sister, Woo-Hui, steps forward to marry in her place. But for Woo-Hui, this decision isn't just about a marriage of convenience—it's a strategy to win over Min Jae-Heon, the man she's secretly loved for years?! Caught up in Woo-Hui's refreshing charm, Jae-Heon finds himself helplessly swept away before he even realizes it...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

206662.description:
Can men and women be "just friends"? Do-Eun has a terrible track record with love. After yet another breakup leaves her in shambles, she finds herself with nowhere to go. Then her friend Han-Joo offers to let her move in. They've been friends forever, so sharing a place shouldn't change anything, right?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Men and Women Shouldn't Sit Together After Age Seven

206663.description:
On the first floor of the Lafayette Apartments, facing demolition, Eve runs ‘Moon Dumpling’. One cold winter day, she takes in Rex, a handsome flower-picking vagrant. In truth, Rex is the building's sole heir and a notorious troublemaker in Manhattan high society! For some reason, he pretends to be a flower-picking vagrant, stays at ‘Moon Dumpling,’ and helps Eve. Eve is shaken by Rex, who dashes around calling her Noona. What will become of their relationship?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

206665.description:
Strange events always unfold around genius boy Kai and mysterious girl Yuu. One day, Kai deciphers the ancient “Voynich Manuscript” and begins cultivating eerie plants. Attacked by a cat-shaped delivery man, Kai is kidnapped along with Yuu and the plant—but what happens next?

A war of proliferating new lifeforms, planetary alignment within the school, unsettling prophetic dreams, the appearance of demons—will they confront these bizarre phenomena and difficult cases with brains and a carefree attitude?! A fantastical horror comedy where uniquely colorful characters run wild!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

206666.description:
To mark the 55th anniversary of the artistic career of the genius artist Daijiro Morohoshi—the “master of the extraordinary” who continues to command respect from many creators, including the late Osamu Tezuka—we are publishing the complete 12-volume Daijiro Morohoshi Tanpen Shuusei. This first-ever compilation chronologically captures the full scope of Morohoshi's uniquely diverse, dreamlike short stories—spanning genres from his earliest works to his latest—including previously uncollected pieces.

The first release is volume two, featuring 11 works including the early masterpieces Shitsurakuen and Manhattan no Kurofune.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

206671.description:
The setting is Imperial Russia. A young girl, Minya, grew up persecuted and called ”witch” and ”red snow” due to a superstition. After losing her home and falling into poverty, in a strange twist of fate, her hidden music talent is recognized by the great composer Tchaikovsky.

(Source: Tezukaosamu.net, translated)

Note: published in Shoujo no Tomo 1955/01-05

ひきこもり王子の華麗なる世直し

206675.description:
"I never signed up to be this wild dog's owner!"

A suspenseful, exciting, and "disciplinary" love story!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: 白銀シロのしつけかた

206677.description:
After the passing of his parents, Koutarou finds himself managing their coffee shop alone. His only companion is a cat and, despite concerns from those around him about his loneliness, Koutarou struggles to forge deep connections with others. One day, a self-proclaimed angel appears before him—Rudy.

“I’ve been waiting. I want to hear you sing,” Rudy says. Koutarou’s heart skips a beat—he had abandoned music a long time ago. Rudy decides to move in with Koutarou—not that Koutarou agreed to anything—and, from there, their life as housemates begins…

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 君と奏でるラブソング
お前が可愛いからいけない！

206679.description:
Former kendo prodigy Jae-Hyeok has lost his way, spiraling far from his golden days. The only person capable of reining him in is Yeong-Won, a steadfast police officer with a heart of gold. Though they couldn’t be more different, these single fathers find their back into each other's lives. As Jae-Hyeok moves in to learn the ropes of parenting, his Alpha instincts awaken, blurring the lines between duty and desire in a domestic whirlwind romance.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

206680.description:
One day, Akira, the granddaughter of the head of the Momiji gang, brings home a ragged young man named Sora who she finds collapsed in a garbage dump. At first, Sora shows a rebellious attitude, saying "I won't accept charity from the yakuza," but gradually he begins to call Akira "boss" and become attached to her...

The story depicts the misunderstandings that surround Akira and Sora as they live together.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: Mr.マロウブルー～After The Rain～
title.romaji: Mr. Mallow Blue: After The Rain

206683.description:
Yamada, who works as an ordinary company employee, goes to visit the family home left behind as an inheritance by his late grandfather, and there he finds a door to another world!!

Beyond the door, he meets a talking black cat and a homunculus girl, and as he begins living together with them, he enjoys a cheat magic life in modern Japan and a heartwarming slow life in another world♪

The best-of-both-worlds life of 35-year-old bachelor Yamada, between another world and reality, begins!

206684.description: Vino, a member of the A-class adventurer party Assault, is a potion user, the weakest and lowest level job. He meets a beautiful swordsman named Canadia, who is known as the God of Death. He was kicked out of the party and nearly died in a monster attack, but Vino awakened by chance with the single-minded desire to protect her! He discovered his own strong shoulders and a new way to use potions, even throwing potions to blast monsters to pieces.

206685.description:
Ritsuka takes his time to notice something.

Note: Released as a booklet bundled with the limited edition of Loveless Volume 9.

206686.description:
I couldn’t stand him—the way he’d smile at me for no reason at all.

Minato is a high school student who has lived his life avoiding connection with others. Takarae is a convenience store clerk who is loved by everyone and moves through life with effortless grace. The two met in the parking lot behind the store, and their relationship consisted of nothing more than exchanging words during Takarae’s break.

Though Minato feels a deep-seated discomfort toward Takarae and his constant desire to "get closer," a major turning point is about to arrive.

Is this friendship, or something else...? Thus begins a relationship that is pure, clumsy, and beautifully distorted.

(Source: Cygames, translated)
synonyms: From That Day, the Answer was Always You

title.native: あの日から、答えはすべて君になった。
title.romaji: Ano Hi kara, Kotae wa Subete Kimi ni Natta.

206687.description:
I can make a living without causing any trouble, and although my salary isn't particularly high, I have some private time. Of course it would be nice if I could live my life however I like, but that's something only a select few can do. So I don't have high expectations, and I'm happy just to maintain this lifestyle.

That's what I thought--
Until I met him and learned about that world.

The story of Okubo, a young man who likes the ordinary and hates to stray from the path, begins now in the world of "design."

(Source: Cygames, translated)

206688.description:
"A woman on the battlefield is always looked down upon, but he was the only one to treat me as an equal..."

In the kingdom of Alderia, First Princess Leone defies the norms by rejecting dresses for iron armor and serving her country as a knight general. Nicknamed the "Golden Lion," she is feared for her bold courage in battle. However, in the midst of a military conflict, Leone unexpectedly receives a proposal of marriage from Zergios, her enemy nation on the brink of collapse. Surprisingly, it comes from none other than Marshal Berthold, someone with whom she has clashed swords many times in the past. A man of few words and a brusque demeanor, Berthold's conversations with Leone mirror the exchanges between two seasoned military figures. Gradually, however, his straightforward approach begins to break down Leone's barriers. Where will this marriage take these two people whose lives have revolved around nothing but the sword?

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: A General e o Comandante: Um Casamento Entre Rivais

title.english: From General to Bride: Marrying My Strongest Rival
title.native: 金髪の姫将軍は元敵国の好敵手に嫁ぐ
title.romaji: Kinpatsu no Hime Shougun wa Mototekikoku no Koutekishu ni Totsugu

206689.description:
Poor Marisa, she's lost her memory and is apparently pregnant! Nick feels compelled to help the lost and confused Marisa. But then Nick turns out to be Nico, the second son of three princes from a royal family. Nico takes it upon himself to look after Marisa, who has to put up with the accusations of the royal family. Soon Marisa finds herself being passionate about her cooking, and even though she isn't sure whether she's friend or foe, Marisa keeps herself busy by cooking and cleaning. Just when Marisa is starting to fit in, she meets a man who shocks her memories back into her. What could have happened to Marisa before losing her memory? Will Nico be able to come to Marisa's rescue again?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: チョコレート・プリンセス

206690.description:
Caitlin and her boss, David, are not only secretary and employer, but lovers, as well. When she met him four months ago, Caitlin quickly fell under the spell of his charm. But David only wanted a sweet, temporary affair with no complications. How can there be a future for them when they want such different things?

(Source: Renta!)

206691.description:
One morning as Tazzy opens her door to go to work, she finds a gift on her doorstep from an unknown sender. Her boss says the gift was probably sent for Valentine's Day, but Tazzy has no idea who the sender could be. And anyway, she doesn't want Ross to think that she has a romantic partner in her life! Tazzy has secretly been in love with Ross for a long time. The mystery only deepens, though, as her admirer continues to send her gifts!

(Source: Renta!)

206692.description:
Ali's goal is buying a house to make her mother happy, which is why she became a model-to earn her nest egg. One day, she receives news that her uncle died and left his estate to her! There's one condition she has to meet, which is that she must marry within a month of his death. She decides a marriage of convenience is the answer, so she proposes a deal to window cleaner Jethro. He then gives her a piercing stare, looking totally different from his usual sweet self, and she wonders who he really is.

(Source: Renta!)

206693.description:
Crushed beneath enormous debt, Angel decides to risk it all by going to a party for the rich and famous to find a husband and turn her life around! If all goes well, she'll finally be free. And during the party, who should approach her but Earl Rafe McFarland, ruggedly handsome, scarred and, of course, very rich. So Angel steels herself to do anything to get him to marry her-anything.

(Source: Renta!)

206694.description:
Bella, the daughter of a wealthy family, disgraced the Balfour name and was banished to the desert as punishment. She had lived in the city and led an exciting life-she couldn't bear the uncivilized life of the desert camp, so she decided to escape to a nearby village... Sheikh Zafiq, the country's ruler, was headed to the desert for his yearly week of relaxation and meditation when he rescues a woman who has collapsed in his path. What will happen to these opposites who met in the middle of the desert? What will happen when they start living in an oasis together under the same roof?

(Source: Renta!)

206695.description:
Libby Westerling deeply cares about children,so when the children's ward needs to raise money she volunteers herself in an auction. Just as she thinks she's about to be bought by a despicable man,she is saved by a prince charming,Dr. Andreas Christakos. Even so,she isn't interested in falling in love due to her distrust of men. But that doesn't stop Andreas. He is confident that Libby will soon realize her feelings for him. Much to Libby's dismay,they even have to work together,so avoiding Andreas's advances will be even harder for her. Will Andreas be able to break through the wall around Libby's heart?

(Source: Renta!)

206696.description:
A devastating car accident has taken a loving couple away from their newborn daughter. She's been given to her godparents to be raised, but one's a rich playboy, and the other's an earnest nanny that the world believes is a home-wrecker. Mario offers Sabrina a fortune to raise the child with him. Will she find that she can fake love if she makes enough money doing so? Mario may have slept around in the past, but will the love Sabrina has for her goddaughter spread some goodwill to the orphan's godfather? Mario might just make this woman an offer she can't refuse-his riches and his heart.

(Source: Renta!)

206697.description:
Yancie, a driver for a large company, notices that she is nearly out of gas one day when she's out in one of the company cars. Panicking, she cuts across another lane of traffic to refuel. At that moment, a horn blares, and she nearly collides with a luxury car. A man exits the car to accuse her of reckless driving, but a startled Yancie gets angry herself and calls him a "noisy old man"! The next day, when she's called into the president's office at work, she's prepared to be upbraided. But she isn't prepared to come face-to-face with the same noisy man!

(Source: Renta!)

206698.description:
Ever since her great-grandmother first told her about her life in Italy, Gabriella has wanted to visit there. So she enters a study- abroad program, and becomes best friends with a local named Giovanni. Giovanni isn't just an ordinary Italian-he's the heir of the prestigious Provere family. His brother, Luca, is studying to become another in a long line of family priests. Luca and Gabriella are instantly drawn to each other, but a relationship is impossible given Luca's future-and the single kiss they share torments them both.

(Source: Renta!)

206699.description:
Pippa has been a guest at the Alderly estate for a long while, ever since her father went missing. With few apparent prospects, she does her best not to be a burden on Lady Alderly and those around her. Meanwhile, Hermione, the young lady of the house, waits for Dominic Alderly to return from the war so they can be wed. But when Dominic returns, his war wounds horrify everyone who has been waiting for him. The only one who doesn't seem to mind them is the compassionate Pippa, whose beauty and kindness quickly capture Dominic's heart.

(Source: Renta!)

206700.description:
While house-sitting in a high-class apartment, Bethany is so mesmerized by an expensive dress she discovers in the closet that she tries it on without permission. Just then, she hears a knock on the front door. What should she do? There's no way that the owner is back already... She timidly opens the door to find a shockingly handsome man standing there. Cristiano, emperor of the business world, mistakes Bethany for the wealthy owner of the apartment. Despite knowing his mistake, Bethany gives in to his seduction and turns her body over to him-knowing all the while that it's only a matter of time before he discovers her deception!

(Source: Renta!)

206701.description:
Tess and Rafe are childhood friends. They've never really seen each other as more than that in the past (well, almost never). When Tess returned to her hometown as a single parent, Rafe, despite being very surprised, was there to support the two of them as a friend. Until, one night, everything changes. A distraught Tess has been told that her son may be taken away from her, and Rafe is there to comfort her. And in doing so he comes to the realization that he wants to be more than just friends. Can he be the man Tess and her child deserve?

(Source: Renta!)

206702.description:
Kim's boyfriend, fed up with her marriage phobia, has split, leaving her alone again. Luckily Kim can always turn to Jax. Whenever she's been depressed or broken-hearted, Jax has listened to her and cheered her up. Surely she can turn to him again...even if it has been six years since they last saw each other. But for the first time Jax gives her the cold shoulder. He treats her as a good friend but doesn't let her get any closer than that. And worse, Jax is always with a woman who's his business partner. Kim begins to realize that she's had feelings for him all along, but has she missed her chance to make Jax hers?

(Source: Renta!)

206703.description:
Carlee made up her mind to have her late husband's baby through artificial insemination. But then the sperm bank tells her there has been a mix-up-the sperm used to impregnate her actually belongs to Hal Ward, a world-famous race-car driver who is also an heir to a prominent family. So now Carlee is pregnant with the baby of a man she's never met! She's further tested when a representative of the Ward family comes to say that, as the child will be a successor to the estate, she is advised to marry Hal. Even though the proposal is outrageous, she agrees to visit the manor. There she meets Hal, a very attractive man, except he doesn't seem to be interested in the marriage they're proposing at all!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 条件つきのウエディング

206704.description:
Emily has fallen into a pit of distrust after being betrayed by her lover, and even a business trip to Italy can't seem to raise her spirits. But on her trip she runs into a man named Giovanni in a small shop, a handsome man beaming with geniality. And after their encounter, the two can't seem to stop running into one another. Could this be...destiny? No! Emily was betrayed once before, and everyone knows men can be frivolous and fickle. Yet no matter how far Emily tries to get from Giovanni, something seems to keep bringing them together.

(Source: Renta!)

206707.description:
"If I had a second life, wouldn't I be a ‘hero’ again?"

Solfort Enuma is an old soldier who has spent more than 60 years training to become a 'hero'. He was an ordinary man with no talent, but he never gave up and continued to pursue his dream.

One day, Solfort faced the 'hero' he had always longed for, but his sword failed to strike a blow and he met an unrewarding end...

It was supposed to happen, but Solfort found himself reincarnated as a young girl...!

Now her (his) heroic tale begins, as she (he) changes her name to Sol, to once again pursue the dream that did not come true in her previous life!
synonyms: The Heroic Tale of Shura Young Girl: A Mercenary Who was Said to be Half-Baked is Reincarnated as a Young Girl and Rises to Success

206709.description:
Being dumped hurts, but being dumped AND swindled hurts more, which leads Kyouko to the rooftop of a building in hopes of ending her suffering. That is until another girl, named Mirai, who has same problems as her, comes up to the same rooftop to do the exact same thing. Could this be a twisted coincidence? or a beautiful miracle in disguise?

Note: Published in Comic Yuri Hime S 2009-05

title.native: はくしゃくのお気に入り

206714.description:
A martial arts champion is merely someone who has reached the top within the bounds of rules.The true strongest is someone who has reached the top in a "fight" with no rules at all!!
A delinquent boxing unfolds place at the worst delinquent high school, where a battle for the top spot unfolds with just his fists!!

206715.description:
Sara, who works in a bookstore, is interested in Jared Cameron, one of her customers. A handsome man who has just moved to town, he's not the type to be open with others. But there is something sweet in his attitude that only Sara can see, and she quickly falls in love with him. One day he is escorting Sara home from a party when meaningful conversation and a kiss ignite their passions. Sara is swept away by the romance of it all, but the night that began so sweetly will soon become terribly cruel.

(Source: Renta!)

206716.description:
Decima Ross, unmarried at twenty-seven, has resigned herself to the life of a spinster. Her height and spindly figure have made finding a match difficult. Then, in the middle of a snowstorm, she meets Adam Grantham, Viscount Weston. The two are snowed in for days in a hunting lodge, alone but for two servants who are laid up in bed. Although they bond while caring for their servants and the house, Decima parts with no plans to see Adam again. Adam searches for her, but is stopped by his own engagement. The path to love is filled with twists and turns and mismatched partners, but fate will always try to set things right.

(Source: Renta!)

206717.description:
Jo, a doctor, was worried about her coworker Ripley who was struggling to recover from his recent divorce. There is no doubt that Ripley loved his beautiful ex-wife from the bottom of his heart. But it hurts Jo to see him in pain because secretly she has feelings toward him. Will she be brave enough to tell him how she feels? And what will happen when Ripley finds out his ex-wife is pregnant?

(Source: Renta!)

206718.description:
Carys's ex-lover Alessandro, an Italian count in the Mattani family, has reappeared. They met two years ago at a ski resort, where Carys instantly fell in love with his passion, sexy body and vibrant emerald eyes. She believed her happiness would last forever, but he doubted Carys's fidelity and cruelly threw her away. Carys's bitter memories of their past heighten her unease, until he ensnares her with the same meltingly sweet, forceful kiss that seduced her once before!

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kioku no Naka no Kimi e

206719.description:
In a world just a little further in the future, one night, Iroha, a caring and highly skilled high school girl, picks up Kaguya, a princess from the moon. At Kaguya's invitation, the energetic and unconventional, the two decide to become live streamers (liver) in the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." As the girls deepen their bond through music, their destinies begin to unfold.

This is the story of "Princess Kaguya" as no one has ever seen it before.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

206720.description: Hanagaoka Haru, a first-year middle school student. After transferring schools again and again, her “special skill” has become the ability to get along reasonably well with anyone, anywhere. Choosing a quiet, uneventful life without causing waves, Haru arrives at her fourth transfer school, in Kitami City, Hokkaido. There, she meets Kutsune Mashiro, a girl completely devoted to the sport of curling. The moment Haru encounters curling—and Mashiro—she feels a sharp, almost painful surge of passion and longing she’s never known before. Sliding, colliding, and pushing forward— This is a sparkling coming-of-age curling story about awkward yet earnest middle school girls!

206721.description:
"I want clothes that won't reveal my geekiness..." That decision was made years ago. This is an unprecedented fashion essay about battling one's own complexes, being defeated by worldly desires, being confused by desires, and harboring longings in one's heart!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

206722.description:
Jane Atteras brings a severed head to Dr. Maels. It speaks of a factory in Antarctica. The birthplace of humanity. Or what they think is humanity. Before long, a secret expedition is underway-- a pilgrimage, if you will, to the homeland. Only, more powerful nations have caught wind and are setting sail. What will kill them first? Their fellow humans, the cold, or something much worse?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Desire grows within. And someday, it reveals itself. What awaits within the story you've chosen?

(Source: Naver, translated)

206725.description:
My boyfriend announced his marriage to me. And that too... to another woman. That's how our four-year relationship crumbled in an instant. To make matters worse, he proposed she become his mistress. Do-Eun refused and they broke up. Later, while on a business trip to Hawaii, Do-Eun met a man with exotic looks named Ian on the beach. Feeling overwhelmed by the intensity of their relationship, Do-Eun continued seeing him under a pseudonym.

“Mo...Ana. My name is Moana.”

They spent passionate nights together, neither knowing the other's name or age, considering it a fleeting encounter destined to be just a memory of Hawaii. Until he reappeared.

“Long time no see, Moana. Or should I call you Director Eun Do-Eun now?”

(Source: Naver, translated)

206730.description:
She's a hard worker, and a witch, but she's also worthless. Her name is Pompurupipipi Pop! Welcome to the world of gags and magic by Arawi Keiichi.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

206731.description:
Feeling out of place in the countryside, high school dropout Nina Iseri moves to Tokyo. After a rough first day and getting locked out of her apartment, she meets her favorite guitarist, Momoka Kawaragi. The two put on a street performance together and decide to start a band with three other girls. While each girl faces her own struggles, their passion for music keeps their dreams alive.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Fully expecting it to be just a one-night thing, Taiga finds himself in an unexpected situation when a language barrier causes a misunderstanding. To make matters more complicated, his casual hookup left out one key detail about who they really are… A story between a trashy DJ/Model and an overwhelmingly beautiful stranger.

206739.description:
It was spring break after middle school when Sky Toochika rescued a tiny girl in a packed train, as she barely even stood a chance against all those people.

When he starts high school, the grade-schooler he thought she was turns up right here in his very classroom!? Her name is Chito Naruse: rather small, but drop-dead gorgeous—oh, and also a total energy addict. Then the little Chito-chan hits Toochika-kun straight up with a confession!?

"I'm a devoted fan of tall, older onee-sans—so a cute, pint-sized girl like Chito-chan is not exactly my type. After turning her down, though, she just said that she'll twist my preferences outa shape… I'm kinda terrified!"

Before long the two are spending time together as friends, and Toochika starts to see more than just the cute little girl in her……

A romantic comedy about an older-women-loving boy, a tiny girl, and their tug-of-war over preferences kicks off!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

What the heck is a "cat knight"!? Transported to another world where cats don't exist, he has only his beloved cat to rely on. And... she's been turned into a giant!

206766.description:
Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Leave all the problems in the slums to the best duo of jack-of-all-trades: Dona, the strongest macho man, and Theo, the super wild and reckless guy who loves Dona!

206789.description:
2009 marks the 50th anniversary of the founding of Gekiga Koubou, a landmark event that sparked a gekiga boom in the rental manga industry of the time and laid the foundation for the enduring popularity of youth manga and adult manga that continues to this day. To mark this occasion, our company is reissuing the first issues of Kage and Machi—pivotal publications that served as cornerstones for the development of gekiga and drove the short-story magazine boom—in a two-volume set. These reissues faithfully replicate the original binding, color schemes, and book design as closely as possible. Each set includes an explanatory booklet featuring testimonials from individuals involved at the time, bringing these works to contemporary readers.

This long-awaited, precious reprint offers both general readers and researchers a chance to discover the roots of modern manga.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

A mother begins to suspect her two daughters, Hakuto and Lily of having a more than "sibling-like" relationship. Is it true that their lovers? Or has their mother just got too much time on her hands?

Note: Published in Comic Yuri Hime S 2009-02

206794.description:
Rito Kohinata has just transferred to Saint Astraia Girls' School. She meets Iori Tsukimori, secretary of the student council and idol of the school.
</br>
She enjoys her school life with her, but Iori suddenly decides to create a new student council. Rito, wondering about her motives, decides to fight alongside the current council...

</br>

206796.description: In the 11th Century BC, a group of thirsty travellers found an oasis in this desert. Suddenly, they were pulled down into the oasis, except for a man - "Yanshi". This oasis has been given the name "Sunset Spring" and it is believed that it can take away the souls of mankind.

206797.description:
Valentina Jiang had a long-standing crush on Levi Bo. One day, she woke up in a hotel room and found him sleeping right next to her. And just like that, she became Levi’s fiancee. No one in her family had a reason to tear her down now. Thistlewood’s elites respected and fawned all over her as Levi showered her with all the love and attention in the world.

(Source: WebComics)

206799.description:
"SHE’S A DEMON!"

Lin Feilu was a "green tea girl"—bright and lovely on the surface, but bitter and calculating, outing f-boys for sport. Then, she awoke as a cute little princess of the Lin Dynasty! Feilu is the emperor’s fifth daughter, born to Lady Lan of the imperial harem. She, her beloved mother, and her twin brother are bullied nearly to death by the emperor’s other wives and children because her brother is different. But Feilu will protect her family since she’s a cunning mastermind!

(Source: Tapas)

206800.description:
Reborn in South Korea in 2026, former hero Yong Sa-Jun struggles to adjust to a world without magic or dragons. After surviving a brutal job market, he finally lands a position at a major corporation - only to come face to face with the man he once loved in his past life: the prince he failed to save. Haunted by memories of tragedy, Sa-Jun tries to keep his distance. But when he discovers that the prince has been cursed, Sa-Jun resolves to save him once again…even if it means juggling deadlines and danger alike!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: พนักงานใหม่ผู้เคยเป็นนักรบ

206801.description:
Lee Yeon-Jun is burdened with profound guilt, watching his older brother, Lee Yeon-O, sacrifice everything to support him due to his frail health. Desperate to free Yeon-O from this lifelong obligation, Yeon-Jun intentionally pushes his brother away with harsh words and sets out for Las Vegas. His goal is to survive on his own terms by fulfilling a lifelong dream: defeating Dius, the undisputed king of Texas Hold 'em poker, and securing the astronomical prize money.

However, Yeon-Jun's grand plan for independence takes a horrific turn on his very first night in the city of sin. While navigating the neon-lit streets, he accidentally stumbles into a dark alleyway and witnesses the brutal murder of a mysterious man named Anapa. Suddenly, Yeon-Jun's desperate quest for financial freedom transforms into a dangerous game of survival, where the stakes are far higher than any poker tournament he could ever play.

(Source: Lezhin US)

206807.description:
Fever at the drop of a hat, joint pain so severe it makes holding chopsticks difficult, heart palpitations that make daily life hard, overwhelming depression, severe insomnia...

Early menopause arriving at the young age of thirty. Experiencing a full spectrum of menopausal symptoms earlier than most, the protagonist gradually realizes these symptoms are simply one manifestation of aging that eventually comes to everyone. Just as the records of the Imjin War during the Joseon Dynasty's Seonjo era were preserved in the ‘Jingbirok’ (Record of Admonition), she aims to create Menopause Chronicles to share wisdom and warn against future troubles, preserving this knowledge as a webtoon.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

206808.description:
"I just want to live my life listening to someone's orders and being praised..."

Is that a sinful, unrealistic dream? Yet, that was the sole wish of ordinary high school student Akira Tamanoi. Days without dreams or motivation... One day, as punishment for being late, Akira is assigned to help the student council and meets the intelligent and beautiful student council president, Makoto Miyauchi. And then, something unexpected happens. Miyauchi constantly asks Akira for favors. "Please... thank you!" "You can't do it? You did well!" Without understanding the meaning of the comfort given to him by Miyauchi, Akira becomes completely engrossed in this suddenly realized dream... There he was, my wonderful master.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
